<h3 id="fetch-a-monitor-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|owner|object \| null|false|none|Team or user that owns the monitor|
|» type|string|true|none|Whether the actor is a user or a team|
|» id|string|true|none|ID of the user or team|
|» name|string|true|none|Display name of the user, or slug of the team|
|» email|string|false|none|Email address of the user. Only set for users|
|createdBy|string \| null|false|none|ID of the user who created the monitor|
|latestGroup|object \| null|false|none|Latest issue the monitor created|
|» id|string|true|none|ID of the issue|
|» title|string|true|none|Title of the issue|
|» culprit|string \| null|true|none|Function or module where the issue occurs|
|» shortId|string \| null|true|none|Short ID of the issue, such as PROJECT-1A|
|» level|string|true|none|Severity level of the issue|
|» status|string|true|none|Issue status|
|» substatus|string \| null|true|none|Substatus of the issue, such as ongoing, regressed or escalating|
|» platform|string \| null|true|none|Platform of the issue's events|
|» project|object|true|none|Project the issue belongs to|
|» » id|string|true|none|ID of the project|
|» » name|string|true|none|Name of the project|
|» » slug|string|true|none|Slug of the project|
|» » platform|string \| null|true|none|Platform of the project|
|» type|string|true|none|Event type of the issue, such as error or default|
|» issueType|string|true|none|Issue type, such as error or performance_n_plus_one_db_queries|
|» issueCategory|string|true|none|Issue category, such as error or performance|
|» metadata|object|true|none|Issue metadata|
|» » title|string|false|none|Title of default and issue platform events|
|» » value|string|false|none|Exception value, or the subtitle of an issue|
|» » type|string|false|none|Exception type of error events|
|» » synthetic|boolean|false|none|Whether the SDK fabricated the exception to carry a stacktrace, so its type is a platform label rather than what went wrong|
|» » filename|string|false|none|File of the frame where the error happened|
|» » function|string|false|none|Function of the frame where the error happened|
|» » message|string|false|none|Message of default, security and feedback events|
|» » uri|string|false|none|URI that a CSP report blocked|
|» » directive|string|false|none|CSP directive that was violated|
|» » origin|string|false|none|Host name of HPKP, Expect-CT and Expect-Staple reports|
|» » name|string|false|none|Name of the person who sent user feedback|
|» » contact_email|string|false|none|Email of the person who sent user feedback|
|» » source|string|false|none|Where user feedback came from, such as a widget|
|» » in_app_frame_mix|string|false|none|Whether the stacktrace has in-app frames, system frames or both|
|» » stripped_crash|boolean|false|none|Whether a crash report was dropped because the issue already stores the most allowed|
|» » sdk|object|false|none|SDK of the issue's first event|
|» » » name|string|true|none|Name of the SDK, or unknown|
|» » » name_normalized|string|true|none|Name of the SDK, normalized for grouping|
|» » severity|number(double)|false|none|Severity score of the issue's first event|
|» » severity_reason|string|false|none|Why the severity score is what it is|
|» » initial_priority|integer|false|none|Priority the issue was created with|
|» numComments|integer|true|none|Number of comments on the issue|
|» firstSeen|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|When the issue was first seen (ISO 8601)|
|» lastSeen|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|When the issue was last seen (ISO 8601)|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Description of the monitor|
|id|string|true|none|Monitor ID|
|projectId|string \| null|true|none|ID of the project the monitor belongs to|
|name|string|true|none|Monitor name|
|type|string|true|none|Type of the monitor, such as metric_issue or error|
|workflowIds|[string]|true|none|IDs of the alerts connected to the monitor|
|dateCreated|string(date-time)|true|none|When the monitor was created (ISO 8601)|

## Update a Monitor by ID

<a id="opIdupdateOrganizationDetector"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/detectors/0/' \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "config": {
      "detectionType": "percent",
      "comparisonDelta": 3600
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/detectors/{detector_id}/`

Update an existing monitor

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "config": {
    "detectionType": "percent",
    "comparisonDelta": 3600
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-monitor-by-id-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|detector_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the monitor you'd like to query.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the monitor.|
|» type|body|string|false|The type of monitor - `metric_issue`.|
|» workflowIds|body|[integer]|false|The IDs of the alerts to connect this monitor to. Use the 'Fetch Alerts' endpoint to find the IDs.|
|» dataSources|body|[object]|false|<br>            The data sources for the metric monitor to use based on what you want to measure.<br><br>            The schema of each data source lists the `aggregate` values that its `dataset` and<br>            `eventTypes` accept.<br><br>            `timeWindow` is measured in seconds. Cron Monitors use schedules instead of this field.<br>            Legacy metric alert rules expressed this value in minutes, so multiply a legacy value<br>            by 60 when migrating it to a monitor. For example, a legacy 5-minute window becomes<br>            `"timeWindow": 300`.<br><br>            **Number of Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count()",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Users Experiencing Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count_unique(tags[sentry:user])",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br><br>            **Throughput Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"count(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Duration Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Failure Rate Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"failure_rate()",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Largest Contentful Paint Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are `avg(measurements.lcp)`, `p50(measurements.lcp)`, `p75(measurements.lcp)`, `p95(measurements.lcp)`, `p99(measurements.lcp)`, and `p100(measurements.lcp)`.<br><br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(measurements.lcp)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"is_transaction:true",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Custom Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are:<br>            `avg(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p50(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p75(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p95(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p99(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p100(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `failure_rate()`<br>            `apdex(x)`, where `x` is the value of the Apdex score.<br>            `count()`<br><br>            ```json<br>            [<br>                {<br>                    "aggregate": "p75(measurements.ttfb)",<br>                    "dataset": "events_analytics_platform",<br>                    "environment": "prod",<br>                    "queryType": 1,<br>                    "eventTypes": ["trace_item_span"],<br>                    "query": "is_transaction:true",<br>                    "timeWindow": 3600,<br>                    "extrapolationMode": "unknown"<br>                }<br>            ]<br>            ```<br>|

|» config|body|object|false|<br>            The issue detection type configuration.<br><br><br>            - `detectionType`<br>                - `static`: Threshold based monitor<br>                - `percent`: Change based monitor<br>                - `dynamic`: Dynamic monitor<br>            - `comparisonDelta`: If selecting a **change** detection type, the comparison delta is the time period, in seconds, at which to compare against historical data.<br>            For example, a value of 3600 compares the metric tracked against data 1 hour ago.<br>                - `300`: 5 minutes<br>                - `900`: 15 minutes<br>                - `3600`: 1 hour<br>                - `86400`: 1 day<br>                - `604800`: 1 week<br>                - `2592000`: 1 month<br><br>            **Threshold**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "static"<br>            }<br>            ```<br>            **Change**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "percent",<br>                "comparisonDelta": 3600<br>            }<br>            ```<br>            **Dynamic**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "dynamic"<br>            }<br>            ```<br>        |
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» conditionGroup|body|object|false|<br>            Issue detection configuration for when to create an issue and at what priority level.<br><br><br>            - `logicType`: `any`<br>            - `type`: Any of `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), or `anomaly_detection` (dynamic)<br>            - `comparison`: Any positive integer. This is threshold that must be crossed for the monitor to create an issue, e.g. "Create a metric issue when there are more than 5 unresolved error events".<br>                - If creating a **change** monitor, `comparison` is the current value as a percentage of the value `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier, not the size of the change. For example, use `120` with `gt` for 20% higher, or `70` with `lt` for 30% lower.<br>                - If creating a **dynamic** monitor, see the options below.<br>                    - `seasonality`: `auto`<br>                    - `sensitivity`: Level of responsiveness. Options are one of `low`, `medium`, or `high`<br>                    - `thresholdType`: If you want to be alerted to anomalies that are moving above, below, or in both directions in relation to your threshold.<br>                        - `0`: Above<br>                        - `1`: Below<br>                        - `2`: Above and below<br><br>            - `conditionResult`: The issue state change when the threshold is crossed.<br>                - `75`: High priority<br>                - `50`: Low priority<br>                - `0`: Resolved<br><br><br>            **Threshold Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Change Monitor** (20% higher than `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier)<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Threshold Monitor with Medium Priority**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 5,<br>                        conditionResult: 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 50<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "lte",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Dynamic Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "anomaly_detection",<br>                        "comparison": {<br>                            "seasonality": "auto",<br>                            "sensitivity": "medium",<br>                            "thresholdType": 2<br>                        },<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br>        |

|» » conditions|body|[object]|false|none|
|» owner|body|string \| null|false|<br>            The ID user or team who owns the monitor or alert prefaced by the string 'user' or 'team'.<br><br>            **User**<br>            ```json<br>                "user:123456"<br>            ```<br><br>            **Team**<br>            ```json<br>                "team:456789"<br>            ```<br>        |
|» description|body|string \| null|false|A description of the monitor. Will be used in the resulting issue.|

|» dataSources|body|[object]|false|<br>            The data sources for the metric monitor to use based on what you want to measure.<br><br>            The schema of each data source lists the `aggregate` values that its `dataset` and<br>            `eventTypes` accept.<br><br>            `timeWindow` is measured in seconds. Cron Monitors use schedules instead of this field.<br>            Legacy metric alert rules expressed this value in minutes, so multiply a legacy value<br>            by 60 when migrating it to a monitor. For example, a legacy 5-minute window becomes<br>            `"timeWindow": 300`.<br><br>            **Number of Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count()",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Users Experiencing Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count_unique(tags[sentry:user])",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br><br>            **Throughput Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"count(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Duration Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Failure Rate Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"failure_rate()",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Largest Contentful Paint Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are `avg(measurements.lcp)`, `p50(measurements.lcp)`, `p75(measurements.lcp)`, `p95(measurements.lcp)`, `p99(measurements.lcp)`, and `p100(measurements.lcp)`.<br><br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(measurements.lcp)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"is_transaction:true",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Custom Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are:<br>            `avg(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p50(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p75(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p95(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p99(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p100(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `failure_rate()`<br>            `apdex(x)`, where `x` is the value of the Apdex score.<br>            `count()`<br><br>            ```json<br>            [<br>                {<br>                    "aggregate": "p75(measurements.ttfb)",<br>                    "dataset": "events_analytics_platform",<br>                    "environment": "prod",<br>                    "queryType": 1,<br>                    "eventTypes": ["trace_item_span"],<br>                    "query": "is_transaction:true",<br>                    "timeWindow": 3600,<br>                    "extrapolationMode": "unknown"<br>                }<br>            ]<br>            ```<br>|

|» conditionGroup|body|object|false|<br>            Issue detection configuration for when to create an issue and at what priority level.<br><br><br>            - `logicType`: `any`<br>            - `type`: Any of `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), or `anomaly_detection` (dynamic)<br>            - `comparison`: Any positive integer. This is threshold that must be crossed for the monitor to create an issue, e.g. "Create a metric issue when there are more than 5 unresolved error events".<br>                - If creating a **change** monitor, `comparison` is the current value as a percentage of the value `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier, not the size of the change. For example, use `120` with `gt` for 20% higher, or `70` with `lt` for 30% lower.<br>                - If creating a **dynamic** monitor, see the options below.<br>                    - `seasonality`: `auto`<br>                    - `sensitivity`: Level of responsiveness. Options are one of `low`, `medium`, or `high`<br>                    - `thresholdType`: If you want to be alerted to anomalies that are moving above, below, or in both directions in relation to your threshold.<br>                        - `0`: Above<br>                        - `1`: Below<br>                        - `2`: Above and below<br><br>            - `conditionResult`: The issue state change when the threshold is crossed.<br>                - `75`: High priority<br>                - `50`: Low priority<br>                - `0`: Resolved<br><br><br>            **Threshold Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Change Monitor** (20% higher than `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier)<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Threshold Monitor with Medium Priority**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 5,<br>                        conditionResult: 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 50<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "lte",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Dynamic Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "anomaly_detection",<br>                        "comparison": {<br>                            "seasonality": "auto",<br>                            "sensitivity": "medium",<br>                            "thresholdType": 2<br>                        },<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br>        |

## Delete a Monitor

<a id="opIddeleteOrganizationDetector"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/detectors/0/' \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/detectors/{detector_id}/`

Delete a monitor

<h3 id="delete-a-monitor-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|detector_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the monitor you'd like to query.|

<h3 id="delete-a-monitor-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
auth_token
</aside>

## Create a Monitor for a Project

<a id="opIdcreateOrganizationProjectDetector"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/projects/string/detectors/' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Unresolved errors",
    "type": "metric_issue",
    "dataSources": [
      {
        "query_type": 0,
        "dataset": "events",
        "query": "is:unresolved",
        "aggregate": "count()",
        "time_window": 3600,
        "environment": "production",
        "event_types": [
          "error",
          "default"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "conditionGroup": {
      "logicType": "any",
      "conditions": [
        {
          "type": "gt",
          "comparison": 10,
          "conditionResult": 75
        },
        {
          "type": "lte",
          "comparison": 10,
          "conditionResult": 0
        }
      ]
    },
    "config": {
      "detectionType": "static"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/projects/{project_id_or_slug}/detectors/`

Create a Monitor for a project

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Unresolved errors",
  "type": "metric_issue",
  "dataSources": [
    {
      "query_type": 0,
      "dataset": "events",
      "query": "is:unresolved",
      "aggregate": "count()",
      "time_window": 3600,
      "environment": "production",
      "event_types": [
        "error",
        "default"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "conditionGroup": {
    "logicType": "any",
    "conditions": [
      {
        "type": "gt",
        "comparison": 10,
        "conditionResult": 75
      },
      {
        "type": "lte",
        "comparison": 10,
        "conditionResult": 0
      }
    ]
  },
  "config": {
    "detectionType": "static"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-monitor-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|project_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the project the resource belongs to. Project slugs are unique within each organization.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the monitor.|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of monitor - `metric_issue`.|
|» workflowIds|body|[integer]|false|The IDs of the alerts to connect this monitor to. Use the 'Fetch Alerts' endpoint to find the IDs.|
|» dataSources|body|[object]|false|<br>            The data sources for the metric monitor to use based on what you want to measure.<br><br>            The schema of each data source lists the `aggregate` values that its `dataset` and<br>            `eventTypes` accept.<br><br>            `timeWindow` is measured in seconds. Cron Monitors use schedules instead of this field.<br>            Legacy metric alert rules expressed this value in minutes, so multiply a legacy value<br>            by 60 when migrating it to a monitor. For example, a legacy 5-minute window becomes<br>            `"timeWindow": 300`.<br><br>            **Number of Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count()",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Users Experiencing Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count_unique(tags[sentry:user])",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br><br>            **Throughput Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"count(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Duration Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Failure Rate Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"failure_rate()",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Largest Contentful Paint Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are `avg(measurements.lcp)`, `p50(measurements.lcp)`, `p75(measurements.lcp)`, `p95(measurements.lcp)`, `p99(measurements.lcp)`, and `p100(measurements.lcp)`.<br><br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(measurements.lcp)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"is_transaction:true",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Custom Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are:<br>            `avg(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p50(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p75(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p95(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p99(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p100(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `failure_rate()`<br>            `apdex(x)`, where `x` is the value of the Apdex score.<br>            `count()`<br><br>            ```json<br>            [<br>                {<br>                    "aggregate": "p75(measurements.ttfb)",<br>                    "dataset": "events_analytics_platform",<br>                    "environment": "prod",<br>                    "queryType": 1,<br>                    "eventTypes": ["trace_item_span"],<br>                    "query": "is_transaction:true",<br>                    "timeWindow": 3600,<br>                    "extrapolationMode": "unknown"<br>                }<br>            ]<br>            ```<br>|

|» config|body|object|false|<br>            The issue detection type configuration.<br><br><br>            - `detectionType`<br>                - `static`: Threshold based monitor<br>                - `percent`: Change based monitor<br>                - `dynamic`: Dynamic monitor<br>            - `comparisonDelta`: If selecting a **change** detection type, the comparison delta is the time period, in seconds, at which to compare against historical data.<br>            For example, a value of 3600 compares the metric tracked against data 1 hour ago.<br>                - `300`: 5 minutes<br>                - `900`: 15 minutes<br>                - `3600`: 1 hour<br>                - `86400`: 1 day<br>                - `604800`: 1 week<br>                - `2592000`: 1 month<br><br>            **Threshold**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "static"<br>            }<br>            ```<br>            **Change**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "percent",<br>                "comparisonDelta": 3600<br>            }<br>            ```<br>            **Dynamic**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "dynamic"<br>            }<br>            ```<br>        |

|» conditionGroup|body|object|false|<br>            Issue detection configuration for when to create an issue and at what priority level.<br><br><br>            - `logicType`: `any`<br>            - `type`: Any of `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), or `anomaly_detection` (dynamic)<br>            - `comparison`: Any positive integer. This is threshold that must be crossed for the monitor to create an issue, e.g. "Create a metric issue when there are more than 5 unresolved error events".<br>                - If creating a **change** monitor, `comparison` is the current value as a percentage of the value `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier, not the size of the change. For example, use `120` with `gt` for 20% higher, or `70` with `lt` for 30% lower.<br>                - If creating a **dynamic** monitor, see the options below.<br>                    - `seasonality`: `auto`<br>                    - `sensitivity`: Level of responsiveness. Options are one of `low`, `medium`, or `high`<br>                    - `thresholdType`: If you want to be alerted to anomalies that are moving above, below, or in both directions in relation to your threshold.<br>                        - `0`: Above<br>                        - `1`: Below<br>                        - `2`: Above and below<br><br>            - `conditionResult`: The issue state change when the threshold is crossed.<br>                - `75`: High priority<br>                - `50`: Low priority<br>                - `0`: Resolved<br><br><br>            **Threshold Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Change Monitor** (20% higher than `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier)<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Threshold Monitor with Medium Priority**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 5,<br>                        conditionResult: 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 50<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "lte",<br> This is threshold that must be crossed for the monitor to create an issue, e.g. "Create a metric issue when there are more than 5 unresolved error events".<br>                - If creating a **change** monitor, `comparison` is the current value as a percentage of the value `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier, not the size of the change. Cron Monitors use schedules instead of this field.<br>            Legacy metric alert rules expressed this value in minutes, so multiply a legacy value<br>            by 60 when migrating it to a monitor. For example, a legacy 5-minute window becomes<br>            `"timeWindow": 300`.<br><br>            **Number of Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count()",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Users Experiencing Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count_unique(tags[sentry:user])",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br><br>            **Throughput Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"count(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Duration Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Failure Rate Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"failure_rate()",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Largest Contentful Paint Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are `avg(measurements.lcp)`, `p50(measurements.lcp)`, `p75(measurements.lcp)`, `p95(measurements.lcp)`, `p99(measurements.lcp)`, and `p100(measurements.lcp)`.<br><br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(measurements.lcp)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"is_transaction:true",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Custom Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are:<br>            `avg(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p50(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p75(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p95(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p99(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p100(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `failure_rate()`<br>            `apdex(x)`, where `x` is the value of the Apdex score.<br>            `count()`<br><br>            ```json<br>            [<br>                {<br>                    "aggregate": "p75(measurements.ttfb)",<br>                    "dataset": "events_analytics_platform",<br>                    "environment": "prod",<br>                    "queryType": 1,<br>                    "eventTypes": ["trace_item_span"],<br>                    "query": "is_transaction:true",<br>                    "timeWindow": 3600,<br>                    "extrapolationMode": "unknown"<br>                }<br>            ]<br>            ```<br>|

"comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Change Monitor** (20% higher than `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier)<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Threshold Monitor with Medium Priority**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 5,<br>                        conditionResult: 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 50<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "lte",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Dynamic Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "anomaly_detection",<br>                        "comparison": {<br>                            "seasonality": "auto",<br>                            "sensitivity": "medium",<br>                            "thresholdType": 2<br>                        },<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br>        |
|» » id|body|integer|false|none|
|» » logicType|body|string|true|* `any`<br>* `any-short`<br>* `all`<br>* `none`|
|» » conditions|body|[object]|false|none|
|» owner|body|string \| null|false|<br>            The ID user or team who owns the monitor or alert prefaced by the string 'user' or 'team'.<br><br>            **User**<br>            ```json<br>                "user:123456"<br>            ```<br><br>            **Team**<br>            ```json<br>                "team:456789"<br>            ```<br>        |
|» description|body|string \| null|false|A description of the monitor. Will be used in the resulting issue.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Set to False if you want to disable the monitor.|

## Fetch Alerts

<a id="opIdlistOrganizationWorkflows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/workflows/' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/`

Returns a list of alerts for a given organization

<h3 id="fetch-alerts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|sortBy|query|string|false|The field to sort results by. If not specified, the results are sorted by id.<br><br>Available fields are:<br>- `name`<br>- `id`<br>- `dateCreated`<br>- `dateUpdated`<br>- `connectedDetectors`<br>- `actions`<br>- `priorityDetector`<br><br>Prefix with `-` to sort in descending order.<br>    |
|query|query|string|false|An optional search query for filtering alerts.|
|id|query|[integer]|false|The ID of the alert you'd like to query.|
|detector|query|[integer]|false|The IDs of monitors connected to the alerts you'd like to query.|
|type|query|[string]|false|The type of workflow you'd like to query. If not specified, all types are returned.|
|project|query|[integer \| string]|false|The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects.<br>For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?project=1234&project=56789`<br>- `/?project=android&project=javascript-react`<br>- `/?project=-1`<br>|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
auth_token
</aside>

## Mutate an Organization's Alerts

<a id="opIdupdateOrganizationWorkflows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/workflows/' \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "enabled": true
  }'
```

`PUT /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/`

Bulk enable or disable alerts for a given Organization

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "enabled": true
}
```

<h3 id="mutate-an-organizations-alerts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|query|query|string|false|An optional search query for filtering alerts.|
|id|query|[integer]|false|The ID of the alert you'd like to query.|
|project|query|[integer \| string]|false|The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects.<br>For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?project=1234&project=56789`<br>- `/?project=android&project=javascript-react`<br>- `/?project=-1`<br>|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» enabled|body|boolean|true|Whether to enable or disable the alerts|

<h3 id="mutate-an-organizations-alerts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<h3 id="mutate-an-organizations-alerts-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[object]|false|none|none|
|» id|string|true|none|Workflow ID|
|» name|string|true|none|Workflow name|
|» type|string|true|none|Type of the workflow, such as alert|
|» organizationId|string|true|none|ID of the organization the workflow belongs to|
|» createdBy|string \| null|true|none|ID of the user who created the workflow|
|» dateCreated|string(date-time)|true|none|When the workflow was created (ISO 8601)|
|» dateUpdated|string(date-time)|true|none|When the workflow was last updated (ISO 8601)|
|» triggers|object \| null|true|none|Conditions on which the workflow triggers|
|» » id|string|false|none|ID of the condition group|
|» » organizationId|string|false|none|ID of the organization|
|» » logicType|string|false|none|How the conditions in the group combine|
|» » conditions|[object]|false|none|Conditions in the group|
|» » » id|string|true|none|ID of the condition|
|» » » type|string|true|none|Type of the condition, such as first_seen_event or level|
|» » » comparison|number \| string \| boolean \| object \| integer \| [string]|true|none|Value the condition compares against, which depends on its type|
|» » » » *anyOf*|number|false|none|none|
|» » » » *anyOf*|string|false|none|none|
|» » » » *anyOf*|boolean|false|none|none|
|» » » » *anyOf*|object|false|none|none|
|» » » » comparisonType|string|true|none|Whether the issue must be older or newer than the age|
|» » » » value|integer|true|none|Age of the issue, in units of time|
|» » » » time|string|true|none|Unit of the age|
|» » » » *anyOf*|object|false|none|none|
|» » » » sensitivity|string|true|none|How sensitive anomaly detection is|
|» » » » seasonality|string|true|none|Seasonal pattern that anomaly detection accounts for|
|» » » » thresholdType|integer|true|none|Anomalies to detect: 0 above, 1 below, 2 above or below the expected value|
|» » » » *anyOf*|object|false|none|none|

## Create an Alert for an Organization

<a id="opIdcreateOrganizationWorkflow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/workflows/' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "id": "string",
    "enabled": true,
    "detectorIds": [
      0
    ],
    "config": {
      "property1": null,
      "property2": null
    },
    "environment": "string",
    "triggers": {
      "id": 0,
      "logicType": "any-short",
      "conditions": [
        {
          "id": 0,
          "type": "every_event",
          "comparison": true,
          "conditionResult": null
        }
      ]
    },
    "actionFilters": [
      {
        "id": 0,
        "logicType": "any",
        "conditions": [
          {
            "id": 0,
            "type": "age_comparison",
            "comparison": {
              "comparisonType": "older",
              "value": 0,
              "time": "minute"
            },
            "conditionResult": null
          }
        ],
        "actions": [
          {
            "id": "string",
            "type": "discord",
            "data": {
              "tags": "string"
            },
            "config": {
              "targetIdentifier": "string",
              "targetDisplay": "string",
              "targetType": "specific"
            },
            "status": "string",
            "integrationId": "string"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "owner": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/`

Creates an alert for an organization

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "id": "string",
  "enabled": true,
  "detectorIds": [
    0
  ],
  "config": {
    "property1": null,
    "property2": null
  },
  "environment": "string",
  "triggers": {
    "id": 0,
    "logicType": "any-short",
    "conditions": [
      {
        "id": 0,
        "type": "every_event",
        "comparison": true,
        "conditionResult": null
      }
    ]
  },
  "actionFilters": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "logicType": "any",
      "conditions": [
        {
          "id": 0,
          "type": "age_comparison",
          "comparison": {
            "comparisonType": "older",
            "value": 0,
            "time": "minute"
          },
          "conditionResult": null
        }
      ],
      "actions": [
        {
          "id": "string",
          "type": "discord",
          "data": {
            "tags": "string"
          },
          "config": {
            "targetIdentifier": "string",
            "targetDisplay": "string",
            "targetType": "specific"
          },
          "status": "string",
          "integrationId": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "owner": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-alert-for-an-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the alert|
|» id|body|string|false|The ID of the existing alert|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether the alert is enabled or disabled|
|» detectorIds|body|[integer]|false|The IDs of the monitors to connect this alert to. Use 'Fetch an Organization's Monitors' to find the IDs.|
|» config|body|object|false|<br>        Typically the frequency at which the alert will fire, in minutes.<br><br>        - `0`: 0 minutes<br>        - `5`: 5 minutes<br>        - `10`: 10 minutes<br>        - `30`: 30 minutes<br>        - `60`: 1 hour<br>        - `180`: 3 hours<br>        - `720`: 12 hours<br>        - `1440`: 24 hours<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "frequency": 60<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» environment|body|string \| null|false|The name of the environment for the alert to evaluate in|
|» triggers|body|object|false|The conditions on which the alert will trigger. See available options below.<br>        ```json<br>        {<br>            "triggers": {<br>                "organizationId": "1",<br>                "logicType": "any-short",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "first_seen_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "issue_resolved_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "reappeared_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "regression_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "seer_activity_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": [<br>                            "rca_completed",<br>                            "solution_completed",<br>                            "coding_completed",<br>                            "pr_ready_for_review"<br>                        ],<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            }<br>        }<br>        ```<br>        |
|» » id|body|integer|false|none|

|» » » type|body|string|true|none|
