|» » » conditionResult|body|object|true|none|
|» actionFilters|body|[object]|false|The filters to run before the action will fire and the action(s) to fire.<br><br>        `logicType` can be one of `any-short`, `all`, or `none`.<br><br>        Below is a basic example. See below for all other options.<br><br>        ```json<br>            "actionFilters": [<br>                {<br>                    "logicType": "any",<br>                    "conditions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "type": "level",<br>                            "comparison": {<br>                                "level": 50,<br>                                "match": "eq"<br>                            },<br>                            "conditionResult": true<br>                        }<br>                    ],<br>                    "actions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "id": "123",<br>                            "type": "email",<br>                            "integrationId": null,<br>                            "data": {},<br>                            "config": {<br>                                "targetType": "user",<br>                                "targetDisplay": null,<br>                                "targetIdentifier": "56789"<br>                            },<br>                            "status": "active"<br>                        }<br>                    ]<br>                }<br>            ]<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Conditions<br><br>        **Issue Age**<br>        - `time`: One of `minute`, `hour`, `day`, or `week`.<br>        - `value`: A positive integer.<br>        - `comparisonType`: One of `older` or `newer`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "age_comparison",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "time": "minute",<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "comparisonType": "older"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Assignment**<br>        - `targetType`: Who the issue is assigned to<br>            - `Unassigned`: Unassigned<br>            - `Member`: Assigned to a user<br>            - `Team`: Assigned to a team<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the user or team from the `targetType`. Enter "" if `targetType` is `Unassigned`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "assigned_to",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "targetType": "Member",<br>                    "targetIdentifier": 123456<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Category**<br>        - `value`: The issue category to filter to.<br>            - `1`: Error issues<br>            - `6`: Feedback issues<br>            - `10`: Outage issues<br>            - `11`: Metric issues<br>            - `12`: DB Query issues<br>            - `13`: HTTP Client issues<br>            - `14`: Front end issues<br>            - `15`: Mobile issues<br>            - `17`: Preprod issues<br>            - `19`: Configuration issues<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_category",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 1<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Frequency**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing how many times the issue has to happen before the alert will fire.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_occurrences",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **De-escalation**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority threshold the issue must de-escalate below.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_deescalating",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Priority**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority the issue must be for the alert to fire.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_greater_or_equal",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Users Affected**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of users that must be affected before the alert will fire.<br>        - `filters`: A list of additional sub-filters to evaluate before the alert will fire.<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of users affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_unique_user_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "filters": [{"key": "foo", "match": "eq", "value": "bar"}],<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of events in an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percent of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Count**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Percentage of sessions affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Percent**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Attribute**<br>        The event's `attribute` value `match` `value`<br><br>        - `attribute`: The event attribute to match on. Valid values are: `message`, `platform`, `environment`, `type`, `error.handled`, `error.unhandled`, `error.main_thread`, `exception.type`, `exception.value`, `user.id`, `user.email`, `user.username`, `user.ip_address`, `http.method`, `http.url`, `http.status_code`, `sdk.name`, `stacktrace.code`, `stacktrace.module`, `stacktrace.filename`, `stacktrace.abs_path`, `stacktrace.package`, `unreal.crash_type`, `app.in_foreground`.<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_attribute",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "match": "co",<br>                    "value": "bar",<br>                    "attribute": "message"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Tagged Event**<br>        The event's tags `key` match `value`<br>        - `key`: The tag value<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "tagged_event",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "key": "level",<br>                    "match": "eq",<br>                    "value": "error"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Latest Release**<br>        The event is from the latest release<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_release",<br>                "comparison": true,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Release Age**<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_adopted_release",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "environment": "production",<br>                    "ageComparison": "older",<br>                    "releaseAgeType": "oldest"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Level**<br>        The event's level is `match` `level`<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `eq`: Equal<br>            - `gte`: Greater than or equal<br>            - `lte`: Less than or equal<br>        - `level`: The event level<br>            - `50`: Fatal<br>            - `40`: Error<br>            - `30`: Warning<br>            - `20`: Info<br>            - `10`: Debug<br>            - `0`: Sample<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "level",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "level": 50,<br>                    "match": "eq"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Actions<br>        A list of actions that take place when all required conditions and filters for the alert are met. See below for a list of possible actions.<br><br><br>        **Notify on Preferred Channel**<br>        - `data`: A dictionary with the fallthrough type option when choosing to notify Suggested Assignees. Leave empty if notifying a user or team.<br>            - `fallthroughType`<br>                - `ActiveMembers`<br>                - `AllMembers`<br>                - `NoOne`<br>        - `config`: A dictionary with the configuration options for notification.<br>            - `targetType`: The type of recipient to notify<br>                - `user`: User<br>                - `team`: Team<br>                - `issue_owners`: Suggested Assignees<br>            - `targetDisplay`: null<br>            - `targetIdentifier`: The id of the user or team to notify. Leave null for Suggested Assignees.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{},<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"user",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"232692"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            },<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{<br>                    "fallthroughType":"ActiveMembers"<br>                },<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"issue_owners",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":""}<br>                ,<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        **Notify on Slack**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the channel to notify in.<br>        `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"slack",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on PagerDuty**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The severity level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"pagerduty",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"default"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Discord**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["tags"]`: Comma separated list of tags to add to the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"discord",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"12345",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"1234",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "tags":"transaction,environment"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on MSTeams**<br>        - `targetIdentifier` - The integration ID associated with the Microsoft Teams team.<br>        - `targetDisplay` - The name of the channel to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"msteams",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"19:a4b3kghaghgkjah357y6847@thread.skype",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on OpsGenie**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the Opsgenie team.<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the Opsgenie team to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The priority level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"opsgenie",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456-Error-Service",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"P3"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Azure DevOps**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"vsts",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira Server ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira_server",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a GitHub issue**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"github",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                  "additional_fields": {<br>                      "assignee": "",<br>                      "integration": "2345",<br>                      "labels": [],<br>                      "repo": "example-repo",<br>                  },<br>                  "dynamic_form_fields": [<br>                      {<br>                        "choices": [["YourOrg/example-repo", "example-repo"]],<br>                        "default": "YourOrg/example-repo",<br>                        "label": "GitHub Repository",<br>                        "name": "repo",<br>                        "required": true<br>                        "type": "select",<br>                        "updatesForm": true,<br>                        "url": "/extensions/github/search/example-repo/1234567/",<br>                      },<br>                  ],<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |

## Bulk Delete Alerts

<a id="opIddeleteOrganizationWorkflows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/workflows/' \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/`

Bulk delete alerts for a given organization

<h3 id="bulk-delete-alerts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|query|query|string|false|An optional search query for filtering alerts.|
|id|query|[integer]|false|The ID of the alert you'd like to query.|
|project|query|[integer \| string]|false|The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects.<br>For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?project=1234&project=56789`<br>- `/?project=android&project=javascript-react`<br>- `/?project=-1`<br>|

<h3 id="bulk-delete-alerts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|None|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
auth_token
</aside>

## Fetch an Alert

<a id="opIdgetOrganizationWorkflow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/workflows/0/' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/{workflow_id}/`

Returns an alert.

<h3 id="fetch-an-alert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|workflow_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the alert you'd like to query.|

|» actionFilters|body|[object]|false|The filters to run before the action will fire and the action(s) to fire.<br><br>        `logicType` can be one of `any-short`, `all`, or `none`.<br><br>        Below is a basic example. See below for all other options.<br><br>        ```json<br>            "actionFilters": [<br>                {<br>                    "logicType": "any",<br>                    "conditions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "type": "level",<br>                            "comparison": {<br>                                "level": 50,<br>                                "match": "eq"<br>                            },<br>                            "conditionResult": true<br>                        }<br>                    ],<br>                    "actions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "id": "123",<br>                            "type": "email",<br>                            "integrationId": null,<br>                            "data": {},<br>                            "config": {<br>                                "targetType": "user",<br>                                "targetDisplay": null,<br>                                "targetIdentifier": "56789"<br>                            },<br>                            "status": "active"<br>                        }<br>                    ]<br>                }<br>            ]<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Conditions<br><br>        **Issue Age**<br>        - `time`: One of `minute`, `hour`, `day`, or `week`.<br>        - `value`: A positive integer.<br>        - `comparisonType`: One of `older` or `newer`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "age_comparison",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "time": "minute",<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "comparisonType": "older"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Assignment**<br>        - `targetType`: Who the issue is assigned to<br>            - `Unassigned`: Unassigned<br>            - `Member`: Assigned to a user<br>            - `Team`: Assigned to a team<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the user or team from the `targetType`. Enter "" if `targetType` is `Unassigned`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "assigned_to",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "targetType": "Member",<br>                    "targetIdentifier": 123456<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Category**<br>        - `value`: The issue category to filter to.<br>            - `1`: Error issues<br>            - `6`: Feedback issues<br>            - `10`: Outage issues<br>            - `11`: Metric issues<br>            - `12`: DB Query issues<br>            - `13`: HTTP Client issues<br>            - `14`: Front end issues<br>            - `15`: Mobile issues<br>            - `17`: Preprod issues<br>            - `19`: Configuration issues<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_category",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 1<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Frequency**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing how many times the issue has to happen before the alert will fire.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_occurrences",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **De-escalation**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority threshold the issue must de-escalate below.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_deescalating",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Priority**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority the issue must be for the alert to fire.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_greater_or_equal",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Users Affected**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of users that must be affected before the alert will fire.<br>        - `filters`: A list of additional sub-filters to evaluate before the alert will fire.<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of users affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_unique_user_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "filters": [{"key": "foo", "match": "eq", "value": "bar"}],<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of events in an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percent of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Count**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Percentage of sessions affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Percent**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Attribute**<br>        The event's `attribute` value `match` `value`<br><br>        - `attribute`: The event attribute to match on. Valid values are: `message`, `platform`, `environment`, `type`, `error.handled`, `error.unhandled`, `error.main_thread`, `exception.type`, `exception.value`, `user.id`, `user.email`, `user.username`, `user.ip_address`, `http.method`, `http.url`, `http.status_code`, `sdk.name`, `stacktrace.code`, `stacktrace.module`, `stacktrace.filename`, `stacktrace.abs_path`, `stacktrace.package`, `unreal.crash_type`, `app.in_foreground`.<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_attribute",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "match": "co",<br>                    "value": "bar",<br>                    "attribute": "message"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Tagged Event**<br>        The event's tags `key` match `value`<br>        - `key`: The tag value<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "tagged_event",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "key": "level",<br>                    "match": "eq",<br>                    "value": "error"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Latest Release**<br>        The event is from the latest release<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_release",<br>                "comparison": true,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Release Age**<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_adopted_release",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "environment": "production",<br>                    "ageComparison": "older",<br>                    "releaseAgeType": "oldest"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Level**<br>        The event's level is `match` `level`<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `eq`: Equal<br>            - `gte`: Greater than or equal<br>            - `lte`: Less than or equal<br>        - `level`: The event level<br>            - `50`: Fatal<br>            - `40`: Error<br>            - `30`: Warning<br>            - `20`: Info<br>            - `10`: Debug<br>            - `0`: Sample<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "level",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "level": 50,<br>                    "match": "eq"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Actions<br>        A list of actions that take place when all required conditions and filters for the alert are met. See below for a list of possible actions.<br><br><br>        **Notify on Preferred Channel**<br>        - `data`: A dictionary with the fallthrough type option when choosing to notify Suggested Assignees. Leave empty if notifying a user or team.<br>            - `fallthroughType`<br>                - `ActiveMembers`<br>                - `AllMembers`<br>                - `NoOne`<br>        - `config`: A dictionary with the configuration options for notification.<br>            - `targetType`: The type of recipient to notify<br>                - `user`: User<br>                - `team`: Team<br>                - `issue_owners`: Suggested Assignees<br>            - `targetDisplay`: null<br>            - `targetIdentifier`: The id of the user or team to notify. Leave null for Suggested Assignees.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{},<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"user",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"232692"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            },<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{<br>                    "fallthroughType":"ActiveMembers"<br>                },<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"issue_owners",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":""}<br>                ,<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        **Notify on Slack**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the channel to notify in.<br>        `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"slack",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on PagerDuty**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The severity level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"pagerduty",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"default"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Discord**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["tags"]`: Comma separated list of tags to add to the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"discord",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"12345",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"1234",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "tags":"transaction,environment"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on MSTeams**<br>        - `targetIdentifier` - The integration ID associated with the Microsoft Teams team.<br>        - `targetDisplay` - The name of the channel to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"msteams",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"19:a4b3kghaghgkjah357y6847@thread.skype",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on OpsGenie**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the Opsgenie team.<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the Opsgenie team to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The priority level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"opsgenie",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456-Error-Service",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"P3"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Azure DevOps**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"vsts",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira ticket**<br>        - ## Delete an Alert

<a id="opIddeleteOrganizationWorkflow"></a>

  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/{workflow_id}/`

<h3 id="delete-an-alert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|workflow_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the alert you'd like to query.|

|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

## List an Organization's Code Mappings

<a id="opIdlistOrganizationCodeMappings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/code-mappings/' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/code-mappings/`

Return repository path mappings for projects the user can access.

<h3 id="list-an-organizations-code-mappings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|integrationId|query|string|false|Filter mappings to a specific installed integration.|
|project|query|[string]|false|Filter by project ID or slug. Pass `-1` to include all projects the user can access. When omitted, mappings include all projects the user can access.|
|cursor|query|string|false|A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|The maximum number of mappings to return per page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[

    "projectId": "string",
    "projectSlug": "string",
    "repoId": "string",
    "repoName": "string",
    "integrationId": "string",
    "provider": {
      "key": "string",
      "slug": "string",
      "name": "string",
      "canAdd": true,
      "canDisable": true,
      "features": [
        "string"
      ],
      "aspects": {
        "alerts": [
          {
            "type": "string",
            "icon": "string",
            "text": "string"
          }
        ],
        "configure_integration": {
          "title": "string"
        },
        "directEnable": true,
        "disable_dialog": {
          "actionText": "string",
          "body": "string"
        },
        "externalInstall": {
          "url": "string",
          "buttonText": "string",
          "noticeText": "string"
        },
        "removal_dialog": {
          "actionText": "string",
          "body": "string"
        }
      }
    },
    "stackRoot": "string",
    "sourceRoot": "string",
    "defaultBranch": "string",
    "automaticallyGenerated": true,
    "hasCodeOwner": true
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-an-organizations-code-mappings-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<h3 id="list-an-organizations-code-mappings-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[object]|false|none|none|
|» id|string|true|none|ID of the code mapping|
|» projectId|string|true|none|ID of the project|
|» projectSlug|string|true|none|Slug of the project|
|» repoId|string|true|none|ID of the repository|
|» repoName|string|true|none|Name of the repository|
|» integrationId|string \| null|true|none|ID of the repository's integration|
|» provider|object \| null|true|none|Provider of the repository's integration|
|» » key|string|true|none|Key of the integration provider, such as github|
|» » slug|string|true|none|Slug of the integration provider, same as key|
|» » name|string|true|none|Display name of the integration provider|
|» » canAdd|boolean|true|none|Whether the integration can be installed from Sentry|
|» » canDisable|boolean|true|none|Whether the integration must be uninstalled from the provider instead of in Sentry|
|» » features|[string]|true|none|Features the integration provider supports, such as issue-basic or commits|
|» » aspects|object|true|none|Extra provider details shown during setup, such as alerts and configuration instructions|
|» » » alerts|[object]|false|none|Alerts shown during setup|
|» » » » type|string|true|none|Style of the alert, such as warning|
|» » » » icon|string|true|none|Icon shown with the alert, such as icon-warning-sm|
|» » » » text|string|true|none|Text of the alert, in Markdown|
|» » » configure_integration|object|false|none|Configuration step after install|
|» » » » title|string|true|none|Title of the configuration step|
|» » » directEnable|boolean|false|none|Whether the integration is enabled without an install flow|
|» » » disable_dialog|object|false|none|Dialog shown before the integration is disabled|
|» » » » actionText|string|true|none|Label of the dialog's confirm button|
|» » » » body|string|true|none|Text of the dialog|
|» » » externalInstall|object|false|none|Where to install the integration when it's installed outside Sentry|
|» » » » url|string|true|none|URL to install the integration from, such as a marketplace|
|» » » » buttonText|string|true|none|Label of the install button|
|» » » » noticeText|string|true|none|Notice shown before the user leaves Sentry|
|» » » removal_dialog|object|false|none|Dialog shown before the integration is removed|
|» » » » actionText|string|true|none|Label of the dialog's confirm button|
|» » » » body|string|true|none|Text of the dialog|
|» stackRoot|string|true|none|Stack trace path prefix that the mapping replaces|
|» sourceRoot|string|true|none|Repository path prefix that replaces the stack root|
|» defaultBranch|string \| null|true|none|Branch to link source files on|
|» automaticallyGenerated|boolean|true|none|Whether Sentry created the mapping automatically|
|» hasCodeOwner|boolean|true|none|Whether the mapping has a CODEOWNERS file linked|

## Create an Organization Code Mapping

<a id="opIdcreateOrganizationCodeMapping"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/code-mappings/' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "repository_id": 0,
    "project_id": 0,
    "stack_root": "string",
    "source_root": "string",
    "integration_id": 0,
    "default_branch": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/code-mappings/`

Create a repository path mapping for a project and installed integration.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "repository_id": 0,
  "project_id": 0,
  "stack_root": "string",
  "source_root": "string",
  "integration_id": 0,
  "default_branch": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-organization-code-mapping-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» repository_id|body|integer|true|The ID of a repository belonging to the installed integration.|
|» project_id|body|integer|true|The ID of the project to associate with the code mapping.|
|» stack_root|body|string|true|The path prefix to replace in stack trace filenames.|
|» source_root|body|string|true|The repository path prefix to substitute for the stack trace prefix.|
|» integration_id|body|integer|true|The ID of the installed integration that provides the repository.|
|» default_branch|body|string|false|The default branch to use when resolving source files. May be empty for Perforce.|

|» » removal_dialog|object|false|none|Dialog shown before the integration is removed|
|» » » actionText|string|true|none|Label of the dialog's confirm button|
|» » » body|string|true|none|Text of the dialog|
|stackRoot|string|true|none|Stack trace path prefix that the mapping replaces|
|sourceRoot|string|true|none|Repository path prefix that replaces the stack root|
|defaultBranch|string \| null|true|none|Branch to link source files on|
|automaticallyGenerated|boolean|true|none|Whether Sentry created the mapping automatically|
|hasCodeOwner|boolean|true|none|Whether the mapping has a CODEOWNERS file linked|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
auth_token
</aside>

## Create or Update Organization Code Mappings in Bulk

<a id="opIdbulkUpsertOrganizationCodeMappings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/code-mappings/bulk/' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "project": 0,
    "repository": "string",
    "mappings": [
      {
        "stack_root": "string",
        "source_root": "string"
      }
    ],
    "provider": "string",
    "default_branch": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/code-mappings/bulk/`

Create or update multiple repository path mappings for a project. Mappings with matching project, stack root, and source root are updated.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "project": 0,
  "repository": "string",
  "mappings": [
    {
      "stack_root": "string",
      "source_root": "string"
    }
  ],
  "provider": "string",
  "default_branch": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-organization-code-mappings-in-bulk-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» project|body|integer \| string|true|The ID or slug of the project to configure.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» repository|body|string|true|The repository name as it appears in Sentry.|
|» mappings|body|[object]|true|One or more stack-root and source-root mappings (maximum 300).|
|» » stack_root|body|string|true|The path prefix to strip from matching stack frame filenames before adding sourceRoot.|
|» » source_root|body|string|true|The repository path prefix that replaces stackRoot. For example, /app/pkg/file.py with stackRoot=/app/ and sourceRoot=src/ resolves to src/pkg/file.py.|
|» provider|body|string \| null|false|Optional repository provider used to disambiguate or find the repository. If no matching Sentry repository exists, the repository is created after the provider confirms it exists.|
|» default_branch|body|string|false|The repository branch to use; inferred from the integration when omitted.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "created": 0,
  "updated": 0,
  "errors": 0,
  "mappings": [
    {
      "stackRoot": "string",
      "sourceRoot": "string",
      "status": "created",
      "detail": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 207 Response

```json
{
  "created": 0,
  "updated": 0,
  "errors": 0,
  "mappings": [
    {
      "stackRoot": "string",
      "sourceRoot": "string",
      "status": "created",
      "detail": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-organization-code-mappings-in-bulk-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|
|207|Multi-Status|One or more mappings could not be saved.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|
|409|Conflict|Conflict|None|

<h3 id="create-or-update-organization-code-mappings-in-bulk-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created|integer|true|none|Number of mappings created|
|updated|integer|true|none|Number of existing mappings updated|
|errors|integer|true|none|Number of mappings that failed|
|mappings|[object]|true|none|Result for each requested mapping, in request order|
|» stackRoot|string|true|none|Stack trace path prefix of the mapping|
|» sourceRoot|string|true|none|Repository path prefix of the mapping|
|» status|string|true|none|Whether the mapping was created, updated or failed|
|» detail|string|false|none|Why the mapping failed. Only set when status is error|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|created|
|» status|updated|
|» status|error|

Status Code **207**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created|integer|true|none|Number of mappings created|
|updated|integer|true|none|Number of existing mappings updated|
|errors|integer|true|none|Number of mappings that failed|
|mappings|[object]|true|none|Result for each requested mapping, in request order|
|» stackRoot|string|true|none|Stack trace path prefix of the mapping|
|» sourceRoot|string|true|none|Repository path prefix of the mapping|
|» status|string|true|none|Whether the mapping was created, updated or failed|
|» detail|string|false|none|Why the mapping failed. Only set when status is error|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|created|
|» status|updated|
|» status|error|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
auth_token
</aside>

`GET /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/codeowners-associations/`

Return CODEOWNERS associations for projects the authenticated user is a member of. Specify `project` to filter the results.

<h3 id="list-code-owner-associations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|project|query|[string]|false|Filter by project ID or slug. Specify multiple values to include multiple projects. Use `-1` to include all accessible projects.|
|provider|query|string|false|Filter associations by integration provider.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "property1": {
    "associations": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "errors": {
      "missing_user_emails": [
        "string"
      ],
      "missing_external_users": [
        "string"
      ],
      "missing_external_teams": [
        "string"
      ],
      "teams_without_access": [
        "string"
      ],
      "users_without_access": [
        "string"
      ]
    }
  },
  "property2": {
    "associations": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "errors": {
      "missing_user_emails": [
        "string"
      ],
      "missing_external_users": [
        "string"
      ],
      "missing_external_teams": [
        "string"
      ],
      "teams_without_access": [
        "string"
      ],
      "users_without_access": [
        "string"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="list-code-owner-associations-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<h3 id="list-code-owner-associations-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|none|
|» associations|object|true|none|Sentry user or team for each owner in the CODEOWNERS file, keyed by the owner's name in the file|
|» » **additionalProperties**|string|false|none|none|
|» errors|object|true|none|Owners in the CODEOWNERS file that couldn't be associated, by reason|
|» » missing_user_emails|[string]|true|none|Email owners in the CODEOWNERS file with no matching Sentry user|
|» » missing_external_users|[string]|true|none|User owners in the CODEOWNERS file with no external user mapping|
|» » missing_external_teams|[string]|true|none|Team owners in the CODEOWNERS file with no external team mapping|
|» » teams_without_access|[string]|true|none|Teams in the CODEOWNERS file that don't have access to the project|
|» » users_without_access|[string]|true|none|Users in the CODEOWNERS file who aren't members of a team with access to the project|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
auth_token
</aside>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|
|404|Not Found|Bad Request|None|

<h3 id="get-integration-provider-information-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|providers|[object]|true|none|Integration providers available to the organization|
|» key|string|true|none|Key of the integration provider, such as github|
|» slug|string|true|none|Slug of the integration provider, same as key|
|» name|string|true|none|Display name of the integration provider|
|» metadata|object \| null|true|none|Provider metadata, such as description, author, source URL and setup details|
|» » description|string|true|none|Description of the integration, in Markdown|
|» » features|[object]|true|none|Features the integration provides|
|» » » description|string|true|none|Description of the feature, in Markdown|
|» » » featureGate|string \| null|true|none|Organization feature flag that gates the feature, such as integrations-commits|
|» » author|string|true|none|Author of the integration|
|» » noun|string|true|none|Noun for one installation, such as Installation or Account|
|» » issue_url|string|true|none|URL to report problems with the integration|
|» » source_url|string|true|none|URL of the integration's source or docs|
|» » aspects|object|true|none|Extra provider details shown during setup, such as alerts and configuration instructions|
|» » » alerts|[object]|false|none|Alerts shown during setup|
|» » » » type|string|true|none|Style of the alert, such as warning|
|» » » » icon|string|true|none|Icon shown with the alert, such as icon-warning-sm|
|» » » » text|string|true|none|Text of the alert, in Markdown|
|» » » configure_integration|object|false|none|Configuration step after install|
|» » » » title|string|true|none|Title of the configuration step|
|» » » directEnable|boolean|false|none|Whether the integration is enabled without an install flow|
|» » » disable_dialog|object|false|none|Dialog shown before the integration is disabled|
|» » » » actionText|string|true|none|Label of the dialog's confirm button|
|» » » » body|string|true|none|Text of the dialog|
|» » » externalInstall|object|false|none|Where to install the integration when it's installed outside Sentry|
|» » » » url|string|true|none|URL to install the integration from, such as a marketplace|
|» » » » buttonText|string|true|none|Label of the install button|
|» » » » noticeText|string|true|none|Notice shown before the user leaves Sentry|
|» » » removal_dialog|object|false|none|Dialog shown before the integration is removed|
|» » » » actionText|string|true|none|Label of the dialog's confirm button|
|» » » » body|string|true|none|Text of the dialog|
|» canAdd|boolean|true|none|Whether the integration can be installed from Sentry|
|» canDisable|boolean|true|none|Whether the integration must be uninstalled from the provider instead of in Sentry|
|» features|[string]|true|none|Features the integration provider supports, such as issue-basic or commits|

## Create an External User

<a id="opIdcreateOrganizationExternalUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/external-users/' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "user_id": 0,
    "external_name": "string",
    "provider": "github",
    "integration_id": 0,
    "external_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/external-users/`

Link a user from an external provider to a Sentry user.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "user_id": 0,
  "external_name": "string",
  "provider": "github",
  "integration_id": 0,
  "external_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-external-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» user_id|body|integer|true|The user ID in Sentry.|
|» external_name|body|string|true|The associated name for the provider.|
|» provider|body|string|true|The provider of the external actor.<br><br>* `github`<br>* `github_enterprise`<br>* `jira_server`<br>* `slack`<br>* `slack_staging`<br>* `perforce`<br>* `gitlab`<br>* `cursor_origin`<br>* `msteams`<br>* `custom_scm`|
|» integration_id|body|integer|true|The Integration ID.|
|» external_id|body|string \| null|false|The associated user ID for provider.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» provider|github|
|» provider|github_enterprise|
|» provider|jira_server|
|» provider|slack|
|» provider|slack_staging|
|» provider|perforce|
|» provider|gitlab|
|» provider|cursor_origin|
|» provider|msteams|
|» provider|custom_scm|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "externalName": "@Billybob",
  "provider": "github",
  "userId": "1",
  "integrationId": "1",
  "id": "1"
}
```

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "externalName": "@Billybob",
  "provider": "github",
  "userId": "1",
  "integrationId": "1",
  "id": "1"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-external-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|
|201|Created||Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<h3 id="create-an-external-user-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|externalId|string|false|none|ID of the user or team in the provider|
|userId|string|false|none|ID of the Sentry user. Only set for user mappings|
|teamId|string|false|none|ID of the Sentry team. Only set for team mappings|
|id|string|true|none|ID of the external actor mapping|
|provider|string|true|none|Provider of the external actor, such as github or slack|
|externalName|string|true|none|Name of the user or team in the provider, such as @octocat|
|integrationId|string|true|none|ID of the integration the mapping belongs to|

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|externalId|string|false|none|ID of the user or team in the provider|
|userId|string|false|none|ID of the Sentry user. Only set for user mappings|
|teamId|string|false|none|ID of the Sentry team. Only set for team mappings|
|id|string|true|none|ID of the external actor mapping|
|provider|string|true|none|Provider of the external actor, such as github or slack|
|externalName|string|true|none|Name of the user or team in the provider, such as @octocat|
|integrationId|string|true|none|ID of the integration the mapping belongs to|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
auth_token
</aside>

## Update an External User

<a id="opIdupdateOrganizationExternalUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/external-users/0/' \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "user_id": 0,
    "external_name": "string",
    "provider": "github",
    "integration_id": 0,
    "external_id": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/external-users/{external_user_id}/`

Update a user in an external provider that is currently linked to a Sentry user.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "user_id": 0,
  "external_name": "string",
  "provider": "github",
  "integration_id": 0,
  "external_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-external-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|external_user_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the external user object. This is returned when creating an external user.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» user_id|body|integer|true|The user ID in Sentry.|
|» external_name|body|string|true|The associated name for the provider.|
|» provider|body|string|true|The provider of the external actor.<br><br>* `github`<br>* `github_enterprise`<br>* `jira_server`<br>* `slack`<br>* `slack_staging`<br>* `perforce`<br>* `gitlab`<br>* `cursor_origin`<br>* `msteams`<br>* `custom_scm`|
|» integration_id|body|integer|true|The Integration ID.|
|» external_id|body|string \| null|false|The associated user ID for provider.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» provider|github|
|» provider|github_enterprise|
|» provider|jira_server|
|» provider|slack|
|» provider|slack_staging|
|» provider|perforce|
|» provider|gitlab|
|» provider|cursor_origin|
|» provider|msteams|
|» provider|custom_scm|

> Example responses

```json

  "externalName": "@Billybob",
  "provider": "github",
  "userId": "1",
  "integrationId": "1",
  "id": "1"
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-external-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<h3 id="update-an-external-user-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|externalId|string|false|none|ID of the user or team in the provider|
|userId|string|false|none|ID of the Sentry user. Only set for user mappings|
|teamId|string|false|none|ID of the Sentry team. Only set for team mappings|
|id|string|true|none|ID of the external actor mapping|
|provider|string|true|none|Provider of the external actor, such as github or slack|

## Delete an External User

<a id="opIddeleteOrganizationExternalUser"></a>

curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/external-users/0/' \
  -X DELETE \

`DELETE /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/external-users/{external_user_id}/`

|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|external_user_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the external user object. This is returned when creating an external user.|

## Create a Data Forwarder for an Organization

<a id="opIdcreateOrganizationForwarding"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/forwarding/' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "organization_id": 0,
    "provider": "segment",
    "is_enabled": true,
    "enroll_new_projects": false,
    "config": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "project_ids": [
      0
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/forwarding/`

Creates a new data forwarder for an organization.
Only one data forwarder can be created per provider for a given organization.

Project-specific overrides can only be created after creating the data forwarder.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "organization_id": 0,
  "provider": "segment",
  "is_enabled": true,
  "enroll_new_projects": false,
  "config": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "project_ids": [
    0
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-data-forwarder-for-an-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|integer|true|The ID of the organization related to the data forwarder.|
|» provider|body|string|true|The provider of the data forwarder. One of "segment", "sqs", or "splunk".<br><br>* `segment` - Segment<br>* `sqs` - Amazon SQS<br>* `splunk` - Splunk|
|» is_enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether the data forwarder is enabled.|
|» enroll_new_projects|body|boolean|false|Whether to enroll new projects automatically, after they're created.|
|» config|body|object|false|The configuration for the data forwarder, specific to the provider type. <br>For a 'sqs' provider, the required keys are queue_url, region, access_key, secret_key. If using a FIFO queue, you must also provide a message_group_id, though s3_bucket is optional. <br>For a 'segment' provider, the required keys are write_key. <br>For a 'splunk' provider, the required keys are instance_url, index, source, token.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» project_ids|body|[integer]|false|The IDs of the projects connected to the data forwarder. Missing project IDs will be unenrolled if previously enrolled.|

|Parameter|Value|

|» provider|sqs|
|» provider|splunk|

## Update a Data Forwarder for an Organization

<a id="opIdupdateOrganizationForwarding"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/forwarding/0/' \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "organization_id": 0,
    "provider": "segment",
    "is_enabled": true,
    "enroll_new_projects": false,
    "config": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "project_ids": [
      0
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/forwarding/{data_forwarder_id}/`

Updates a data forwarder for an organization or update a project-specific override.
Updates to the data forwarder's configuration require `org:write` permissions, and the entire
configuration to be provided, including the `project_ids` field.

To configure project-specific overrides, specify only the following fields:

  - 'project_id': The ID of the project to create/modify the override for.
  - 'overrides': Follows the same format as `config` but all provider fields are optional, since only specified fields are overridden.
  - 'is_enabled': To enable/disable the forwarder for events on the specific project.

Overrides can be performed with `project:write` permissions on the project being modified.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "organization_id": 0,
  "provider": "segment",
  "is_enabled": true,
  "enroll_new_projects": false,
  "config": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "project_ids": [
    0
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-data-forwarder-for-an-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|data_forwarder_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the data forwarder you'd like to query.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|integer|true|The ID of the organization related to the data forwarder.|
|» provider|body|string|true|The provider of the data forwarder. One of "segment", "sqs", or "splunk".<br><br>* `segment` - Segment<br>* `sqs` - Amazon SQS<br>* `splunk` - Splunk|
|» is_enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether the data forwarder is enabled.|
|» enroll_new_projects|body|boolean|false|Whether to enroll new projects automatically, after they're created.|
|» config|body|object|false|The configuration for the data forwarder, specific to the provider type. <br>For a 'sqs' provider, the required keys are queue_url, region, access_key, secret_key. If using a FIFO queue, you must also provide a message_group_id, though s3_bucket is optional. <br>For a 'segment' provider, the required keys are write_key. <br>For a 'splunk' provider, the required keys are instance_url, index, source, token.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» project_ids|body|[integer]|false|The IDs of the projects connected to the data forwarder. Missing project IDs will be unenrolled if previously enrolled.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» provider|segment|
|» provider|sqs|
|» provider|splunk|

## Update Settings for Organization Repositories

<a id="opIdupdateOrganizationRepositorySettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/organizations/string/repos/settings/' \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{

      0
    ],
    "enabledCodeReview": true,
    "codeReviewTriggers": [
      "on_new_commit"
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/repos/settings/`

Update code review settings for one or more repositories in the organization. Provide at least one of `enabledCodeReview` or `codeReviewTriggers`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "repositoryIds": [
    0
  ],
  "enabledCodeReview": true,
  "codeReviewTriggers": [
    "on_new_commit"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-settings-for-organization-repositories-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» repositoryIds|body|[integer]|true|List of repository IDs to update settings for. Maximum 1000 repositories.|
|» enabledCodeReview|body|boolean|false|Whether code review is enabled for these repositories|
|» codeReviewTriggers|body|[string]|false|List of triggers for code review|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|

|» codeReviewTriggers|on_new_commit|
|» codeReviewTriggers|on_ready_for_review|

]
