Allows parameters to be defined in snake case, but passed as camel case.

Errors are output in camel case.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the monitor.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of monitor - `metric_issue`.|
|workflowIds|[integer]|false|none|The IDs of the alerts to connect this monitor to. Use the 'Fetch Alerts' endpoint to find the IDs.|
|dataSources|[object]|false|none|<br>            The data sources for the metric monitor to use based on what you want to measure.<br><br>            The schema of each data source lists the `aggregate` values that its `dataset` and<br>            `eventTypes` accept.<br><br>            `timeWindow` is measured in seconds. Cron Monitors use schedules instead of this field.<br>            Legacy metric alert rules expressed this value in minutes, so multiply a legacy value<br>            by 60 when migrating it to a monitor. For example, a legacy 5-minute window becomes<br>            `"timeWindow": 300`.<br><br>            **Number of Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count()",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Users Experiencing Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count_unique(tags[sentry:user])",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br><br>            **Throughput Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"count(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Duration Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Failure Rate Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"failure_rate()",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Largest Contentful Paint Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are `avg(measurements.lcp)`, `p50(measurements.lcp)`, `p75(measurements.lcp)`, `p95(measurements.lcp)`, `p99(measurements.lcp)`, and `p100(measurements.lcp)`.<br><br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(measurements.lcp)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"is_transaction:true",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Custom Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are:<br>            `avg(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p50(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p75(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p95(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p99(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p100(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `failure_rate()`<br>            `apdex(x)`, where `x` is the value of the Apdex score.<br>            `count()`<br><br>            ```json<br>            [<br>                {<br>                    "aggregate": "p75(measurements.ttfb)",<br>                    "dataset": "events_analytics_platform",<br>                    "environment": "prod",<br>                    "queryType": 1,<br>                    "eventTypes": ["trace_item_span"],<br>                    "query": "is_transaction:true",<br>                    "timeWindow": 3600,<br>                    "extrapolationMode": "unknown"<br>                }<br>            ]<br>            ```<br>|
|config|object|false|none|<br>            The issue detection type configuration.<br><br><br>            - `detectionType`<br>                - `static`: Threshold based monitor<br>                - `percent`: Change based monitor<br>                - `dynamic`: Dynamic monitor<br>            - `comparisonDelta`: If selecting a **change** detection type, the comparison delta is the time period, in seconds, at which to compare against historical data.<br>            For example, a value of 3600 compares the metric tracked against data 1 hour ago.<br>                - `300`: 5 minutes<br>                - `900`: 15 minutes<br>                - `3600`: 1 hour<br>                - `86400`: 1 day<br>                - `604800`: 1 week<br>                - `2592000`: 1 month<br><br>            **Threshold**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "static"<br>            }<br>            ```<br>            **Change**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "percent",<br>                "comparisonDelta": 3600<br>            }<br>            ```<br>            **Dynamic**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "dynamic"<br>            }<br>            ```<br>        |
|conditionGroup|object|false|none|<br>            Issue detection configuration for when to create an issue and at what priority level.<br><br><br>            - `logicType`: `any`<br>            - `type`: Any of `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), or `anomaly_detection` (dynamic)<br>            - `comparison`: Any positive integer. This is threshold that must be crossed for the monitor to create an issue, e.g. "Create a metric issue when there are more than 5 unresolved error events".<br>                - If creating a **change** monitor, `comparison` is the current value as a percentage of the value `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier, not the size of the change. For example, use `120` with `gt` for 20% higher, or `70` with `lt` for 30% lower.<br>                - If creating a **dynamic** monitor, see the options below.<br>                    - `seasonality`: `auto`<br>                    - `sensitivity`: Level of responsiveness. Options are one of `low`, `medium`, or `high`<br>                    - `thresholdType`: If you want to be alerted to anomalies that are moving above, below, or in both directions in relation to your threshold.<br>                        - `0`: Above<br>                        - `1`: Below<br>                        - `2`: Above and below<br><br>            - `conditionResult`: The issue state change when the threshold is crossed.<br>                - `75`: High priority<br>                - `50`: Low priority<br>                - `0`: Resolved<br><br><br>            **Threshold Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Change Monitor** (20% higher than `comparisonDelta` seconds earlier)<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 120,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Threshold Monitor with Medium Priority**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 5,<br>                        conditionResult: 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "gt",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 50<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "lte",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Dynamic Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "anomaly_detection",<br> Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "anomaly_detection",<br>                        "comparison": {<br>                            "seasonality": "auto",<br>                            "sensitivity": "medium",<br>                            "thresholdType": 2<br>                        },<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br>        |
|owner|string \| null|false|none|<br>            The ID user or team who owns the monitor or alert prefaced by the string 'user' or 'team'.<br><br>            **User**<br>            ```json<br>                "user:123456"<br>            ```<br><br>            **Team**<br>            ```json<br>                "team:456789"<br>            ```<br>        |
|description|string \| null|false|none|A description of the monitor. Will be used in the resulting issue.|
|enabled|boolean|false|none|Set to False if you want to disable the monitor.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The user-defined saved query name.|
|projects|[integer]|false|none|The saved projects filter for this query.|
|queryDataset|string|false|none|The dataset you would like to query. Note: `discover` is a **deprecated** value. The allowed values are: `error-events`, `transaction-like`<br><br>* `discover`<br>* `error-events`<br>* `transaction-like`|
|start|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The saved start time for this saved query.|
|end|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The saved end time for this saved query.|
|range|string \| null|false|none|The saved time range period for this saved query.|
|fields|[string]|false|none|The fields, functions, or equations that can be requested for the query. At most 20 fields can be selected per request. Each field can be one of the following types:<br>- A built-in key field. See possible fields in the [properties table](/product/sentry-basics/search/searchable-properties/#properties-table), under any field that is an event property.<br>    - example: `field=transaction`<br>- A tag. Tags should use the `tag[]` formatting to avoid ambiguity with any fields<br>    - example: `field=tag[isEnterprise]`<br>- A function which will be in the format of `function_name(parameters,...)`. See possible functions in the [query builder documentation](/product/discover-queries/query-builder/#stacking-functions).<br>    - when a function is included, Discover will group by any tags or fields<br>    - example: `field=count_if(transaction.duration,greater,300)`<br>- An equation when prefixed with `equation\|`. Read more about [equations here](/product/discover-queries/query-builder/query-equations/).<br>    - example: `field=equation\|count_if(transaction.duration,greater,300) / count() * 100`<br>|
|orderby|string \| null|false|none|How to order the query results. Must be something in the `field` list, excluding equations.|
|rollup|integer \| null|false|none|Time-bucket granularity in seconds for the saved query.|
|aggregations|[[object]]|false|none|Aggregate functions to apply, each as a `[function, column, alias]` triple.|
|groupby|[string]|false|none|Columns to group results by.|
|conditions|[[object]]|false|none|Filter conditions, each as a `[column, operator, value]` triple.|
|limit|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum number of rows to return, from `0` to `1000`.|
|version|integer \| null|false|none|Saved query schema version. `1` for the legacy shape, `2` for the current one.|
|environment|[string]|false|none|The name of environments to filter by.|
|query|string \| null|false|none|Filters results by using [query syntax](/product/sentry-basics/search/).|
|widths|[string]|false|none|Rendered column widths, in the same order as the query's fields.|
|yAxis|[string]|false|none|Aggregate functions to be plotted on the chart.|
|display|string \| null|false|none|Visualization type for saved query chart. Allowed values are:<br>- default<br>- previous<br>- top5<br>- daily<br>- dailytop5<br>- bar<br>|
|topEvents|integer \| null|false|none|Number of top events' timeseries to be visualized.|
|interval|string \| null|false|none|Resolution of the time series.|

<h2 id="tocS_DynamicSdkLoaderOption">DynamicSdkLoaderOption</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadynamicsdkloaderoption"></a>
<a id="schema_DynamicSdkLoaderOption"></a>
<a id="tocSdynamicsdkloaderoption"></a>
<a id="tocsdynamicsdkloaderoption"></a>

```json
{
  "hasReplay": true,
  "hasPerformance": true,
  "hasDebug": true,
  "hasFeedback": true,
  "hasLogsAndMetrics": true
}
```

Configures multiple options for the Javascript Loader Script.
- `Performance Monitoring`
- `Debug Bundles & Logging`
- `Session Replay` - Note that the loader will load the ES6 bundle instead of the ES5 bundle.
- `User Feedback` - Note that the loader will load the ES6 bundle instead of the ES5 bundle.
- `Logs and Metrics` - Note that the loader will load the ES6 bundle instead of the ES5 bundle. Requires SDK >= 10.0.0.
```json
{
    "dynamicSdkLoaderOptions": {
        "hasReplay": true,
        "hasPerformance": true,
        "hasDebug": true,
        "hasFeedback": true,
        "hasLogsAndMetrics": true
    }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|hasReplay|boolean|false|none|none|
|hasPerformance|boolean|false|none|none|
|hasDebug|boolean|false|none|none|
|hasFeedback|boolean|false|none|none|
|hasLogsAndMetrics|boolean|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_ExplorerAutofixRequest">ExplorerAutofixRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaexplorerautofixrequest"></a>

<a id="tocsexplorerautofixrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "step": "root_cause",
  "stopping_point": "root_cause",
  "run_id": 0,
  "sentry_run_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "integration_id": 0,
  "provider": "string",
  "user_context": "string",
  "repo_name": "string",
  "insert_index": 0,
  "referrer": "string"
}
```

Serializer for the agent-based autofix requests.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|step|string|false|none|Which autofix step to run.<br><br>* `root_cause`<br>* `solution`<br>* `code_changes`<br>* `pr_iteration`<br>* `open_pr`<br>* `coding_agent_handoff`|
|stopping_point|string|false|none|Where the issue fix process should stop. If not provided, will run to root cause.<br><br>* `root_cause`<br>* `solution`<br>* `code_changes`<br>* `open_pr`|
|run_id|integer|false|none|**Deprecated** in favor of sentry_run_id; retained for backward compatibility. The existing run's numeric Seer id to continue. If neither run_id nor sentry_run_id is provided, starts a new run.|
|sentry_run_id|string(uuid)|false|none|Existing run's UUID to continue. Preferred over run_id, and takes precedence when both are given.|
|integration_id|integer|false|none|Coding agent integration ID. Required for coding_agent_handoff step (unless provider is specified).|
|provider|string|false|none|Coding agent provider (e.g., 'github_copilot'). Alternative to integration_id for user-authenticated providers.|
|user_context|string|false|none|Optional user context to append to the step prompt.|
|repo_name|string|false|none|Optional repository name for which to create the pull request. Do not pass a repository name to create pull requests in all relevant repositories.|
|insert_index|integer|false|none|Block index to insert at. When provided, truncates blocks after this point for retry-from-step.|
|referrer|string|false|none|Referrer identifying where the issue fix was triggered from.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|step|root_cause|
|step|solution|
|step|code_changes|
|step|pr_iteration|
|step|open_pr|
|step|coding_agent_handoff|
|stopping_point|root_cause|
|stopping_point|solution|
|stopping_point|code_changes|
|stopping_point|open_pr|

<h2 id="tocS_Filters">Filters</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemafilters"></a>
<a id="schema_Filters"></a>
<a id="tocSfilters"></a>
<a id="tocsfilters"></a>

```json
{
  "filetypes": [
    "pe"
  ],
  "path_patterns": [
    "string"
  ],
  "requires_checksum": true
}
```

Filter settings for the source. This is optional for all sources.

**`filetypes`** ***(list)*** - A list of file types that can be found on this source. If this is left empty, all file types will be enabled. The options are:
- `pe` - Windows executable files
- `pdb` - Windows debug files
- `portablepdb` - .NET portable debug files
- `mach_code` - MacOS executable files
- `mach_debug` - MacOS debug files
- `elf_code` - ELF executable files
- `elf_debug` - ELF debug files
- `wasm_code` - WASM executable files
- `wasm_debug` - WASM debug files
- `breakpad` - Breakpad symbol files
- `sourcebundle` - Source code bundles
- `uuidmap` - Apple UUID mapping files
- `bcsymbolmap` - Apple bitcode symbol maps
- `il2cpp` - Unity IL2CPP mapping files
- `proguard` - ProGuard mapping files

**`path_patterns`** ***(list)*** - A list of glob patterns to check against the debug and code file paths of debug files. Only files that match one of these patterns will be requested from the source. If this is left empty, no path-based filtering takes place.

**`requires_checksum`** ***(boolean)*** - Whether this source requires a debug checksum to be sent with each request. Defaults to `false`.

```json
{
    "filters": {
        "filetypes": ["pe", "pdb", "portablepdb"],
        "path_patterns": ["*ffmpeg*"]
    }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filetypes|[string]|false|none|The file types enabled for the source.|
|path_patterns|[string]|false|none|The debug and code file paths enabled for the source.|
|requires_checksum|boolean|false|none|Whether the source requires debug checksums.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|filetypes|pe|
|filetypes|pdb|
|filetypes|portablepdb|
|filetypes|mach_debug|
|filetypes|mach_code|
|filetypes|elf_debug|
|filetypes|elf_code|
|filetypes|wasm_debug|
|filetypes|wasm_code|
|filetypes|breakpad|
|filetypes|sourcebundle|
|filetypes|uuidmap|
|filetypes|bcsymbolmap|
|filetypes|il2cpp|
|filetypes|proguard|
|filetypes|dartsymbolmap|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|isUnhandled|boolean|false|none|Whether the issue includes unhandled events|
|count|string|false|none|Total number of events in the issue|
|userCount|integer|false|none|Number of users affected by the issue|
|firstSeen|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the issue was first seen (ISO 8601)|
|lastSeen|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the issue was last seen (ISO 8601)|
|derivedData|object|false|none|Additional data derived for the issue. Only included when requested with expand|
|id|string|true|none|ID of the issue|
|shareId|string \| null|true|none|ID used in the issue's public share URL. Null when the issue isn't shared|
|shortId|string \| null|true|none|Short ID of the issue, such as PROJECT-1A|
|title|string|true|none|Title of the issue|
|culprit|string \| null|true|none|Function or module where the issue occurs|
|permalink|string(uri)|true|none|URL of the issue in Sentry|
|logger|string \| null|true|none|Logger of the issue's events|
|level|string|true|none|Severity level of the issue|
|status|string|true|none|Issue status|
|statusDetails|object|true|none|Details of the issue's status, such as when an ignore expires or which release resolves it|
|substatus|string \| null|true|none|Substatus of the issue, such as ongoing, regressed or escalating|
|isPublic|boolean|true|none|Whether the issue is shared publicly|
|platform|string \| null|true|none|Platform of the issue's events|
|priority|string \| null|true|none|Priority of the issue: high, medium or low|
|priorityLockedAt|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|When the priority was last set manually, which stops automatic priority updates (ISO 8601)|
|seerFixabilityScore|number(double) \| null|true|none|Seer's score for how likely the issue is to be fixable|
|seerAutofixLastTriggered|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|When Seer Autofix was last triggered for the issue (ISO 8601)|
|seerExplorerAutofixLastTriggered|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|When the Seer explorer agent last completed an Autofix step for the issue (ISO 8601)|
|project|object|true|none|Project the issue belongs to|
|type|string|true|none|Event type of the issue, such as error or default|
|issueType|string|true|none|Issue type, such as error or performance_n_plus_one_db_queries|
|issueCategory|string|true|none|Issue category, such as error or performance|
|metadata|object|true|none|Issue metadata|
|numComments|integer|true|none|Number of comments on the issue|
|assignedTo|object \| null|true|none|User or team the issue is assigned to|
|isBookmarked|boolean|true|none|Whether the requesting user bookmarked the issue|
|isSubscribed|boolean|true|none|Whether the requesting user is subscribed to the issue|
|subscriptionDetails|object \| null|true|none|Why the requesting user is subscribed to the issue|
|hasSeen|boolean|true|none|Whether the requesting user has seen the issue since it last occurred|
|annotations|[object]|true|none|External issues linked to the issue|
|firstRelease|object \| object \| null|false|none|First release the issue was seen in. Omitted when release is collapsed|
|lastRelease|object \| object \| null|false|none|Latest release the issue was seen in. Omitted when release is collapsed|
|tags|[object]|false|none|Tag keys seen on the issue's events, with their top values. Omitted when tags is collapsed|
|stats|object|false|none|Event counts for the last 24 hours (hourly) and 30 days (daily), as [timestamp, count] pairs. Omitted when stats is collapsed|
|inbox|object \| null|false|none|Why the issue is in the inbox. Only included when requested with expand|
|owners|[object]|false|none|Suggested owners of the issue. Only included when requested with expand|
|forecast|object|false|none|Escalation forecast for the issue. Only included when requested with expand|
|integrationIssues|[object]|false|none|External issues linked through integrations. Only included when requested with expand|
|sentryAppIssues|[object]|false|none|External issues linked through Sentry apps. Only included when requested with expand|
|latestEventHasAttachments|boolean|false|none|Whether the issue's latest event has attachments. Only included when requested with expand|
|activity|[object]|true|none|Recent activity on the issue, newest first|
|seenBy|[object]|true|none|Users who have seen the issue, with when they last saw it|
|userReportCount|integer|true|none|Number of user reports for the issue|
|participants|[object]|true|none|Users participating in the issue|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the issue view.|
|query|string|true|none|The issue search query. Issue search does not support the `AND`/`OR` boolean operators or parenthesized boolean groups. To match any of several values, use the list form instead: `issue:[PROJ-AB1, PROJ-CD2]`, `issue.priority:[high, medium]`.|
|projects|[integer]|true|none|The project IDs included in the view. Use `-1` to include all projects.|
|environments|[string]|true|none|The environment names included in the view. An empty list includes all environments.|
|timeFilters|object|true|none|The time range for the view.|
|querySort|string|false|none|How to sort issues in the view.<br><br>* `date` - Last Seen<br>* `new` - First Seen<br>* `trends` - Trends<br>* `freq` - Events<br>* `user` - Users<br>* `inbox` - Date Added<br>* `recommended` - Recommended|
|starred|boolean|false|none|Whether to star the issue view for the current user.|

|querySort|new|

  },

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|inbox|boolean|false|none|If true, marks the issue as reviewed by the requestor.|
|status|string|false|none|The new status for the issues.<br><br>* `resolved`<br>* `unresolved`<br>* `ignored`<br>* `resolvedInNextRelease`<br>* `muted`|
|statusDetails|object|false|none|Additional details about the resolution. Status detail updates that include release data are only allowed for issues within a single project.|
|substatus|string \| null|false|none|The new substatus of the issue.<br><br>* `archived_until_escalating`<br>* `archived_until_condition_met`<br>* `archived_forever`<br>* `escalating`<br>* `ongoing`<br>* `regressed`<br>* `new`|
|hasSeen|boolean|false|none|If true, marks the issue as seen by the requestor.|
|isBookmarked|boolean|false|none|If true, bookmarks the issue for the requestor.|
|isPublic|boolean|false|none|If true, publishes the issue.|
|isSubscribed|boolean|false|none|If true, subscribes the requestor to the issue.|
|merge|boolean|false|none|If true, merges the issues together.|
|discard|boolean|false|none|If true, discards the issues instead of updating them.|
|assignedTo|string|false|none|The user or team that should be assigned to the issues. Values take the form of `<user_id>`, `user:<user_id>`, `<username>`, `<user_primary_email>`, or `team:<team_id>`.|
|priority|string|false|none|The priority that should be set for the issues<br><br>* `low`<br>* `medium`<br>* `high`|
|ignoreDuration|integer|false|none|Ignore the issue for this many minutes.|
|ignoreCount|integer|false|none|Ignore the issue until it is seen this many more times.|
|ignoreWindow|integer|false|none|Window in minutes over which `ignoreCount` is measured. Maximum is 7 days.|
|ignoreUserCount|integer|false|none|Ignore the issue until it affects this many more users.|
|ignoreUserWindow|integer|false|none|Window in minutes over which `ignoreUserCount` is measured. Maximum is 7 days.|
|snoozeDuration|integer \| null|false|none|Snooze the issue for this many minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|status|resolved|
|status|unresolved|
|status|ignored|

|substatus|escalating|
|substatus|ongoing|

|id|string|true|none|ID of the event|

|projectID|string|true|none|ID of the project the event belongs to|
|message|string \| null|true|none|Event message|
|title|string|true|none|Event title|
|location|string \| null|true|none|Source location of the event, such as a file and line|
|platform|string \| null|true|none|Platform of the event, such as python or javascript|
|dateReceived|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|When Sentry received the event (ISO 8601)|
|size|integer \| null|true|none|Size of the event payload in bytes|
|entries|[object]|true|none|Event interfaces, such as exception, breadcrumbs and request, each with a type and data|
|dist|string \| null|true|none|Distribution of the release the event was sent with|
|packages|object|true|none|Modules loaded when the event occurred, keyed by module name with their versions|
|type|string|true|none|Event type, such as error, default or transaction|
|metadata|object|true|none|Event metadata|
|occurrence|object \| object \| null|true|none|Issue occurrence data for events in non-error issues, such as performance issues. Null otherwise|
|_meta|object|true|none|Metadata about changes Sentry made to the event's fields, such as data scrubbing or trimming|
|user|object \| null|true|none|User context of the event|
|tags|[object]|true|none|Tags attached to the event|
|contexts|object \| null|true|none|Contexts of the event, such as device, os, browser and runtime, keyed by alias|
|sdk|object \| null|true|none|SDK that sent the event|
|context|object \| null|true|none|Additional data sent with the event in its extra field|
|errors|[object]|true|none|Errors Sentry found while processing the event|
|crashFile|string \| null|false|none|Crash report attachment of the event, if any|
|culprit|string \| null|false|none|Function or module that caused the event|
|dateCreated|string(date-time)|false|none|When the event occurred (ISO 8601)|
|fingerprints|[string]|false|none|Grouping hashes calculated for the event|
|groupingConfig|object|false|none|Grouping configuration used to group the event|
|startTimestamp|number(double)|false|none|When the transaction started, as a Unix timestamp in seconds|
|endTimestamp|number(double)|false|none|When the transaction ended, as a Unix timestamp in seconds|
|measurements|object \| null|false|none|Measurements recorded for the transaction, such as web vitals, keyed by name|
|breakdowns|object \| null|false|none|Span operation breakdowns for the transaction, keyed by breakdown name|
|release|object \| null|true|none|Release the event was sent with. Null when the event has no release|
|userReport|object \| null|true|none|User feedback submitted for the event. Null when there's none|
|sdkUpdates|[object]|true|none|Suggested updates for the SDK that sent the event|
|resolvedWith|[string]|true|none|How the event's stack frames were resolved during processing, such as which source map lookup method was used|
|nextEventID|string \| null|true|none|ID of the next event in the issue. Null for the latest event or when adjacentEvents is collapsed|
|previousEventID|string \| null|true|none|ID of the previous event in the issue. Null for the first event or when adjacentEvents is collapsed|
|formatted|object|false|none|The ``formatted`` field the mixin adds to a response when ``?llmFormat`` is requested.<br><br>``content`` is text for the text formats and a serialized JSON object for ``json``, so the<br>response shape is the same whichever format a caller asks for.|

```json
{
  "detail": "string"
}
```

DRF's standard error-body shape: `{"detail": str}`.

Use in `Response[T] | Response[DetailResponse]` annotations on endpoints
whose inline error returns are exactly `Response({"detail": "..."}, status=4xx)`.
Endpoints whose error bodies have richer or different shapes should
declare their own local TypedDicts instead.

<h2 id="tocS_Layout">Layout</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemalayout"></a>
<a id="schema_Layout"></a>
<a id="tocSlayout"></a>
<a id="tocslayout"></a>

```json
{
  "type": "native",
  "casing": "lowercase"
}
```

Layout settings for the source. This is required for HTTP, GCS, and S3 sources.

**`type`** ***(string)*** - The layout of the folder structure. The options are:
- `native` - Platform-Specific (SymStore / GDB / LLVM)
- `symstore` - Microsoft SymStore
- `symstore_index2` - Microsoft SymStore (with index2.txt)
- `ssqp` - Microsoft SSQP
- `unified` - Unified Symbol Server Layout
- `debuginfod` - debuginfod
- `nnsymstore` - Nintendo Symbol Store

**`casing`** ***(string)*** - The layout of the folder structure. The options are:
- `default` - Default (mixed case)
- `uppercase` - Uppercase
- `lowercase` - Lowercase

```json
{
    "layout": {
        "type": "native"
        "casing": "default"
    }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|The source's layout type.<br><br>* `native`<br>* `symstore`<br>* `symstore_index2`<br>* `ssqp`<br>* `unified`<br>* `debuginfod`<br>* `slashsymbols`<br>* `nnsymstore`|
|casing|string|true|none|The source's casing rules.<br><br>* `lowercase`<br>* `uppercase`<br>* `default`|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|native|
|type|symstore|
|type|symstore_index2|
|type|ssqp|
|type|unified|
|type|debuginfod|
|type|slashsymbols|
|type|nnsymstore|
|casing|lowercase|
|casing|uppercase|
|casing|default|

|comment|string|false|none|An optional comment to post to the external issue when linking, if supported by the integration.|

<a id="schema_MonitorValidator"></a>
<a id="tocSmonitorvalidator"></a>
<a id="tocsmonitorvalidator"></a>

```json
{
  "project": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "config": {
    "schedule_type": "crontab",
    "schedule": null,
    "checkin_margin": 1,
    "max_runtime": 1,
    "timezone": "Africa/Abidjan",
    "failure_issue_threshold": 1,
    "recovery_threshold": 1
  },
  "slug": "string",
  "status": "active",
  "owner": "string",
  "is_muted": true
}
```

Allows parameters to be defined in snake case, but passed as camel case.

Errors are output in camel case.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project|string|true|none|The project ID or slug to associate the monitor to.|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the monitor. Used for notifications. If not set the slug will be derived from your monitor name.|
|config|object|true|none|The configuration for the monitor.|
|slug|string|false|none|Uniquely identifies your monitor within your organization. Changing this slug will require updates to any instrumented check-in calls.|
|status|string|false|none|Status of the monitor. Disabled monitors will not accept events and will not count towards the monitor quota.<br><br>* `active`<br>* `disabled`|
|owner|string \| null|false|none|The ID of the team or user that owns the monitor. (eg. user:51 or team:6)|
|is_muted|boolean|false|none|Disable creation of monitor incidents|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|disabled|

<h2 id="tocS_NotebookBlockResponse">NotebookBlockResponse</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->

<a id="schema_NotebookBlockResponse"></a>

<a id="tocsnotebookblockresponse"></a>

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "position": 0,
  "kind": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "content": "string",
  "generationPrompt": "string",
  "generatedContent": "string",
  "output": {},
  "outputStatus": "string",
  "currentExecution": {
    "id": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "executor": "string",
    "schemaVersion": 0,
    "startedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "completedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "error": {}
  },

    "property1": {},
    "property2": {}
  },
  "display": {
    "property1": {},
    "property2": {}
  },
  "dependencies": [
    "string"
  ],
  "parameterKeys": [
    "string"
  ],
  "version": 0,
  "staleAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "createdBy": "string",
  "lastEditedBy": "string",
  "producerKey": "string",
  "producerRevision": 0
}
```

Notebook block. version is the block concurrency token; dependencies are block IDs and
parameterKeys reference notebook parameters. output is the latest successful result and may
remain available during a rerun; currentExecution describes the latest attempt. Poll
execution details for transcript and pending input. producerKey and producerRevision are
set on blocks a producer wrote.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The block ID|
|position|integer|true|none|The block's position in the notebook, starting at 0|
|kind|string|true|none|text for Markdown, or query for a data query|
|title|string|true|none|The block title. May be empty|
|content|string|true|none|The block's content: Markdown for text, the query for query|
|generationPrompt|string|true|none|Instructions used when running the block|
|generatedContent|string|true|none|The latest generated content, before anyone edited it|
|output|object \| null \| [object] \| string \| number \| boolean|true|none|The latest successful result. Text blocks have schemaVersion and markdown|
|outputStatus|string|true|none|available, notRun, or the status of the latest execution|
|currentExecution|object \| null|true|none|The latest execution, if the block has run|
|config|object|true|none|How the block runs, such as auto-run|
|display|object|true|none|How the block is shown. Text uses type markdown; query uses table, line, bar, or area|
|dependencies|[string]|true|none|The IDs of blocks this block depends on|
|parameterKeys|[string]|true|none|The keys of the parameters the block uses|
|version|integer|true|none|The block's concurrency token. Send it as version with a change|
|staleAt|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|When an input changed after the output was made, if one did|
|createdBy|string \| null|true|none|The ID of the user who added the block, if a user did|
|lastEditedBy|string \| null|true|none|The ID of the user who last edited the block, if a user did|
|producerKey|string \| null|true|none|The producer's key for the block, if a producer wrote it|
|producerRevision|integer \| null|true|none|The producer's revision for the block, if a producer wrote it|

<h2 id="tocS_NotebookCreateValidator">NotebookCreateValidator</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemanotebookcreatevalidator"></a>
<a id="schema_NotebookCreateValidator"></a>
<a id="tocSnotebookcreatevalidator"></a>
<a id="tocsnotebookcreatevalidator"></a>

```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "projectIds": [
    1
  ],
  "filters": {
    "property1": null,
    "property2": null
  },
  "source": {
    "type": "string"
  }
}
```

Create a blank notebook, or find or create a producer's notebook for its source.

Needs organization and creator in its context.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|title|string|true|none|Investigation title.|
|projectIds|[integer]|false|none|Unique IDs of accessible projects to include. Defaults to an empty list.|
|filters|object|false|none|Investigation filter object, stored with its original keys.|
|source|object|false|none|What a producer writes this notebook about. type names a registered producer source type, and the other fields depend on it. Projects come from the source, so omit projectIds. An active notebook for the same source is returned instead of a new one.|

IDs, and source context. source.snapshot is present only for source-backed investigations.
actionRequests has Seer's action requests that aren't superseded, plus stale ones while Seer
re-checks them, newest report first, with that report's primary at the top.

|sourceType|string|true|none|What the notebook is about: manual, or a source type|
|createdBy|string \| null|true|none|The ID of the user who created the notebook, if a user did|
|creator|object \| null|true|none|The user or service account that created the notebook|
|dateCreated|string(date-time)|true|none|When the notebook was created|
|dateUpdated|string(date-time)|true|none|When the notebook last changed|
|version|integer|true|none|The notebook's concurrency token. Send it as notebookVersion with a change|
|blockCount|integer|true|none|The number of blocks the notebook has|
|isFavorited|boolean|true|none|Whether the requesting user favorited the notebook|
|titleGeneration|object|true|none|The state of automatic title generation|
|orchestration|object \| null|true|none|The agent's run for the notebook, if it has one|
|template|object \| null|true|none|The template the notebook started from, if any|
|source|object|true|none|What the notebook is about|
|filters|object|true|none|Saved filters, stored with their original keys|
|projectIds|[integer]|true|none|The IDs of the projects the notebook covers|
|parameters|[object]|true|none|The notebook's parameters, in order|
|blocks|[object]|true|none|The notebook's blocks, in order|
|actionRequests|[object]|true|none|Steps the agent suggests, newest report first|

Django Rest Framework serializer for incoming NotificationAction API payloads

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|trigger_type|string|true|none|Type of the trigger that causes the notification. The only supported trigger right now is: `spike-protection`.|
|service_type|string|true|none|Service that is used for sending the notification.<br>- `email`<br>- `slack`<br>- `sentry_notification`<br>- `pagerduty`<br>- `opsgenie`<br>|
|integration_id|integer|false|none|ID of the integration used as the notification service. See<br>[List Integrations](https://docs.sentry.io/api/integrations/list-an-organizations-available-integrations/)<br>to retrieve a full list of integrations.<br><br>Required if **service_type** is `slack`, `pagerduty` or `opsgenie`.<br>|
|target_identifier|string|false|none|ID of the notification target, like a Slack channel ID.<br><br>Required if **service_type** is `slack` or `opsgenie`.<br>|
|target_display|string|false|none|Name of the notification target, like a Slack channel name.<br><br>Required if **service_type** is `slack` or `opsgenie`.<br>|
|projects|[string]|false|none|List of project IDs or slugs that the Notification Action is created for.|
|sentry_app_id|integer|false|none|ID of the custom integration to notify, when the target is a Sentry app.|
|target_type|string|false|none|How the notification target is addressed.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slug|string|false|none|The new slug for the organization, which needs to be unique.|
|name|string|false|none|The new name for the organization.|
|isEarlyAdopter|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to opt-in to new features before they're released to the public.|
|hideAiFeatures|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to hide AI features from the organization.|
|defaultRole|string|false|none|The default role new members will receive.<br><br>* `member` - Member<br>* `admin` - Admin<br>* `manager` - Manager<br>* `owner` - Owner|
|openMembership|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow organization members to freely join any team.|
|eventsMemberAdmin|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow members to delete events (including the delete & discard action) by granting them the `event:admin` scope.|
|alertsMemberWrite|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow members to create, edit, and delete alert rules by granting them the `alerts:write` scope.|
|attachmentsRole|string|false|none|The role required to download event attachments, such as native crash reports or log files.<br><br>* `member` - Member<br>* `admin` - Admin<br>* `manager` - Manager<br>* `owner` - Owner|
|debugFilesRole|string|false|none|The role required to download debug information files, ProGuard mappings and source maps.<br><br>* `member` - Member<br>* `admin` - Admin<br>* `manager` - Manager<br>* `owner` - Owner|
|hasGranularReplayPermissions|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to enable granular replay permissions, allowing per-member access control for replay data.|
|replayAccessMembers|[integer]|false|none|A list of user IDs who have permission to access replay data. Requires the hasGranularReplayPermissions flag to be true to be enforced.|
|avatarType|string|false|none|The type of display picture for the organization.<br><br>* `letter_avatar` - Use initials<br>* `upload` - Upload an image|
|avatar|string|false|none|The image to upload as the organization avatar, in base64. Required if `avatarType` is `upload`.|
|require2FA|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to require and enforce two-factor authentication for all members.|
|allowSharedIssues|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow sharing of limited details on issues to anonymous users.|
|enhancedPrivacy|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to enable enhanced privacy controls to limit personally identifiable information (PII) as well as source code in things like notifications.|
|scrapeJavaScript|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow Sentry to scrape missing JavaScript source context when possible.|
|storeCrashReports|integer|false|none|How many native crash reports (such as Minidumps for improved processing and download in issue details) to store per issue.<br><br>* `0` - Disabled<br>* `1` - 1 per issue<br>* `5` - 5 per issue<br>* `10` - 10 per issue<br>* `20` - 20 per issue<br>* `50` - 50 per issue<br>* `100` - 100 per issue<br>* `-1` - Unlimited|
|allowJoinRequests|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow users to request to join your organization.|
|dataScrubber|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to require server-side data scrubbing for all projects.|
|dataScrubberDefaults|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to apply the default scrubbers to prevent things like passwords and credit cards from being stored for all projects.|
|sensitiveFields|[string]|false|none|A list of additional global field names to match against when scrubbing data for all projects.|
|safeFields|[string]|false|none|A list of global field names which data scrubbers should ignore.|
|scrubIPAddresses|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to prevent IP addresses from being stored for new events on all projects.|
|relayPiiConfig|string|false|none|Advanced data scrubbing rules that can be configured for each project as a JSON string. The new rules will only apply to new incoming events. For more details on advanced data scrubbing, see our [full documentation](/security-legal-pii/scrubbing/advanced-datascrubbing/).<br><br>> Warning: Calling this endpoint with this field fully overwrites the advanced data scrubbing rules.<br><br>Below is an example of a payload for a set of advanced data scrubbing rules for masking credit card numbers from the log message (equivalent to `[Mask] [Credit card numbers] from [$message]` in the Sentry app) and removing a specific key called `foo` (equivalent to `[Remove] [Anything] from [extra.foo]` in the Sentry app):<br>```json<br>{<br>    relayPiiConfig: "{\"rules":{\"0\":{\"type\":\"creditcard\",\"redaction\":{\"method\":\"mask\"}},\"1\":{\"type\":\"anything\",\"redaction\":{\"method\":\"remove\"}}},\"applications\":{\"$message\":[\"0\"],\"extra.foo\":[\"1\"]}}"<br>}<br>```<br>        |
|trustedRelays|[object]|false|none|A list of local Relays (the name, public key, and description as a JSON) registered for the organization. This feature is only available for organizations on the Business and Enterprise plans. Read more about Relay [here](/product/relay/).<br><br>                                          Below is an example of a list containing a single local Relay registered for the organization:<br>                                          ```json<br>                                          {<br>                                            trustedRelays: [<br>                                                {<br>                                                    name: "my-relay",<br>                                                    publicKey: "eiwr9fdruw4erfh892qy4493reyf89ur34wefd90h",<br>                                                    description: "Configuration for my-relay."<br>                                                }<br>                                            ]<br>                                          }<br>                                          ```<br>                                          |
|relayDsnEndpoint|string \| null|false|none|A Relay base URL to use when displaying Client Key DSNs for this organization.|
|issueAlertsThreadFlag|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow the Sentry Slack integration to post replies in threads for an Issue Alert notification. Requires a Slack integration.|
|metricAlertsThreadFlag|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow the Sentry Slack integration to post replies in threads for a Metric Alert notification. Requires a Slack integration.|
|cancelDeletion|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to restore an organization that is pending deletion.|
|apdexThreshold|integer|false|none|Deprecated. Response-time threshold in milliseconds previously used to compute Apdex.|

|orgRole|string|false|none|The organization-level role of the new member. Roles include:<br><br>* `billing` - Can manage payment and compliance details.<br>* `member` - Can view and act on events, as well as view most other data within the organization.<br>* `manager` - Has full management access to all teams and projects. |refs|[object]|false|none|An optional way to indicate the start and end commits for each repository included in a release. Head commits must include parameters ``repository`` and ``commit`` (the HEAD SHA). For GitLab repositories, please use the Group name instead of the slug. |avatar|object|true|none|Organization avatar|

|allowMemberProjectCreation|boolean|true|none|Whether members can create projects|
|allowSuperuserAccess|boolean|true|none|Whether Sentry superusers can access the organization|
|role|string|false|none|Deprecated, use orgRole|
|orgRole|string|false|none|The requesting user's role in the organization|
|planSampleRate|number(double)|false|none|Sample rate of the organization's plan, from 0 to 1|
|desiredSampleRate|number(double)|false|none|Sample rate dynamic sampling aims for, from 0 to 1|
|experiments|object|true|none|Experiment assignments for the organization, mapping each experiment name to active or control|
|isDefault|boolean|true|none|Whether this is the default organization of a single-organization install|
|defaultRole|string|true|none|Role that new members get by default|
|orgRoleList|[object]|true|none|Organization roles available in the organization|
|teamRoleList|[object]|true|none|Team roles available in the organization|
|openMembership|boolean|true|none|Whether members can freely join any team|
|allowSharedIssues|boolean|true|none|Whether limited details of issues can be shared with anonymous users|
|enhancedPrivacy|boolean|true|none|Whether enhanced privacy controls limit personally identifiable information (PII) and source code in things like notifications|
|dataScrubber|boolean|true|none|Whether server-side data scrubbing is required for all projects|
|dataScrubberDefaults|boolean|true|none|Whether the default scrubbers apply to all projects, to keep things like passwords and credit cards from being stored|
|sensitiveFields|[string]|true|none|Additional field names that data scrubbing matches in all projects|
|safeFields|[string]|true|none|Field names that data scrubbers ignore in all projects|
|storeCrashReports|integer|true|none|How many native crash reports to store per issue; 0 is disabled and -1 is unlimited|
|attachmentsRole|string|true|none|Role required to download event attachments, such as native crash reports or log files|
|debugFilesRole|string|true|none|Role required to download debug information files, ProGuard mappings and source maps|
|eventsMemberAdmin|boolean|true|none|Whether members can delete events, through the event:admin scope|
|alertsMemberWrite|boolean|true|none|Whether members can create, edit and delete alert rules, through the alerts:write scope|
|scrubIPAddresses|boolean|true|none|Whether IP addresses are kept from being stored for new events in all projects|
|scrapeJavaScript|boolean|true|none|Whether Sentry scrapes missing JavaScript source context when possible|
|allowJoinRequests|boolean|true|none|Whether users can request to join the organization|
|relayPiiConfig|string \| null|true|none|Advanced data scrubbing rules of the organization as a JSON string, or null|
|relayDsnEndpoint|string \| null|true|none|Relay base URL used when displaying Client Key DSNs, or null|
|trustedRelays|[object]|true|none|Local Relays registered for the organization|
|pendingAccessRequests|integer|true|none|Number of pending requests to join teams in the organization|
|hideAiFeatures|boolean|true|none|Whether AI features are hidden for the organization|
|aggregatedDataConsent|boolean|true|none|Whether the organization agreed to let Sentry use its data in aggregate|
|isDynamicallySampled|boolean|true|none|Whether dynamic sampling keeps less than all events, for the organization or any of its projects|
|issueAlertsThreadFlag|boolean|true|none|Whether the Slack integration posts replies in threads for issue alert notifications|
|metricAlertsThreadFlag|boolean|true|none|Whether the Slack integration posts replies in threads for metric alert notifications|
|requiresSso|boolean|true|none|Whether the requesting user must sign in with SSO to access the organization|
|defaultAutofixAutomationTuning|string|true|none|Default Autofix automation tuning for new projects|
|defaultSeerScannerAutomation|boolean|true|none|Default issue scanner automation for new projects; on seat-based Seer plans, new projects always have it on|
|enableSeerCoding|boolean|true|none|Whether Seer coding is enabled for the organization|
|defaultCodingAgent|string|true|none|Coding agent that automated Autofix runs on new projects hand off to, or seer; applies to seat-based Seer plans|
|defaultCodingAgentIntegrationId|string \| null|true|none|Integration ID of the default coding agent, or null|
|defaultAutomatedRunStoppingPoint|string|true|none|Step where automated Autofix runs on new projects stop by default|
|autoEnableCodeReview|boolean|true|none|Whether code review is turned on for GitHub repositories when they're added|
|autoOpenPrs|boolean|true|none|Whether automated Autofix runs on new projects open pull requests by default|
|defaultCodeReviewTriggers|[string]|true|none|Code review triggers that GitHub repositories get when they're added|
|teams|[object]|true|none|Active teams of the organization|
|projects|[object]|true|none|Active projects of the organization|

|dateStarted|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the release started (ISO 8601)|
|owner|object \| null|false|none|Release owner|
|lastCommit|object \| null|false|none|Most recent commit in the release|
|lastDeploy|object \| null|false|none|Most recent deploy of the release|
|firstEvent|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the release received its first event (ISO 8601)|
|lastEvent|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the release received its most recent event (ISO 8601)|
|currentProjectMeta|object \| null|false|none|Session bounds and neighboring release versions in the current project, when a project is requested|
|userAgent|string \| null|false|none|User agent of the client that created the release|
|adoptionStages|object \| null|false|none|Adoption stage of the release in each project, keyed by project slug|
|id|integer|true|none|Release ID|
|version|string|true|none|Version of the release|
|newGroups|integer|true|none|Number of new issues first seen in the release|
|status|string|true|none|Release status|
|shortVersion|string|true|none|Shortened release version|
|versionInfo|object \| null|true|none|Parsed version information|
|data|object|true|none|Extra data stored on the release|
|commitCount|integer|true|none|Number of commits in the release|
|deployCount|integer|true|none|Number of deploys of the release|
|authors|[object]|true|none|Authors of the release's commits|
|projects|[object]|true|none|Projects in the release|
|*anyOf*|object|false|none|No release with commits was found.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|open|
|status|archived|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|digestsMinDelay|integer|true|none|Minimum time in seconds to wait before sending an issue digest email.|
|digestsMaxDelay|integer|true|none|Maximum time in seconds to wait before sending an issue digest email.|
|securityToken|string|true|none|Token sent with security reports (CSP, Expect-CT, HPKP) so Sentry can verify their origin.|
|securityTokenHeader|string|true|none|Name of the header carrying the security token on inbound security reports.|
|isBookmarked|boolean|false|none|Enables starring the project within the projects tab. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|autofixAutomationTuning|string|false|none|How aggressively Seer runs Autofix on new issues. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.<br><br>* `off`<br>* `super_low`<br>* `low`<br>* `medium`<br>* `high`<br>* `always`|
|seerScannerAutomation|boolean|false|none|Let Seer scan new issues automatically. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSizeStatusChecksEnabled|boolean|false|none|Enable preprod size status checks. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSizeStatusChecksRules|object|false|none|Rules controlling when preprod size status checks fail. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSizePrCommentsEnabled|boolean|false|none|Enable preprod size PR comments. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSizePrCommentsRules|object|false|none|Rules controlling which preprod size changes are posted as PR comments. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksEnabled|boolean|false|none|Enable preprod snapshot status checks.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksFailOnAdded|boolean|false|none|Fail the preprod snapshot status check when snapshots are added.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksFailOnRemoved|boolean|false|none|Fail the preprod snapshot status check when snapshots are removed.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksFailOnChanged|boolean|false|none|Fail the preprod snapshot status check when snapshots change.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksFailOnRenamed|boolean|false|none|Fail the preprod snapshot status check when snapshots are renamed.|
|preprodSizeEnabledByCustomer|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable preprod size analysis. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodDistributionEnabledByCustomer|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable preprod build distribution. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodDistributionPrCommentsEnabledByCustomer|boolean \| null|false|none|Post preprod distribution updates as PR comments. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsEnabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Post preprod snapshot changes as PR comments.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsPostOnAdded|boolean \| null|false|none|Include added snapshots in preprod snapshot PR comments.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsPostOnRemoved|boolean \| null|false|none|Include removed snapshots in preprod snapshot PR comments.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsPostOnChanged|boolean \| null|false|none|Include changed snapshots in preprod snapshot PR comments.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsPostOnRenamed|boolean \| null|false|none|Include renamed snapshots in preprod snapshot PR comments.|
|preprodSizeEnabledQuery|string \| null|false|none|Query selecting which preprod builds are size-analyzed. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodDistributionEnabledQuery|string \| null|false|none|Query selecting which preprod builds are distributed. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|name|string|false|none|The name for the project|
|slug|string|false|none|Uniquely identifies a project and is used for the interface.|
|platform|string \| null|false|none|The platform for the project|
|subjectPrefix|string|false|none|Custom prefix for emails from this project.|
|subjectTemplate|string|false|none|The email subject to use (excluding the prefix) for individual alerts. Here are the list of variables you can use:<br>- `$title`<br>- `$shortID`<br>- `$projectID`<br>- `$orgID`<br>- `${tag:key}` - such as `${tag:environment}` or `${tag:release}`.|
|resolveAge|integer \| null|false|none|Automatically resolve an issue if it hasn't been seen for this many hours. Set to `0` to disable auto-resolve.|
|highlightContext|object|false|none|A JSON mapping of context types to lists of strings for their keys.<br>E.g. `{'user': ['id', 'email']}`|
|highlightTags|[string]|false|none|A list of strings with tag keys to highlight on this project's issues.<br>E.g. `['release', 'environment']`|
|verifySSL|boolean|false|none|Verify SSL certificates when delivering outbound webhooks and service hooks.|
|defaultEnvironment|string \| null|false|none|Environment selected by default when viewing this project.|
|dataScrubber|boolean|false|none|Remove known sensitive values from events before storing them.|
|dataScrubberDefaults|boolean|false|none|Also scrub Sentry's built-in list of sensitive field names.|
|sensitiveFields|[string]|false|none|Additional field names to scrub from events, beyond the defaults.|
|safeFields|[string]|false|none|Field names to exempt from scrubbing, including the built-in defaults.|
|storeCrashReports|integer \| null|false|none|Number of native crash report files to store per issue. Use `-1` for unlimited or `0` to store none.|
|relayPiiConfig|string \| null|false|none|Advanced data scrubbing rules, as a JSON string, applied before events are stored.|
|builtinSymbolSources|[string]|false|none|Identifiers of Sentry-hosted symbol sources to use when symbolicating events.|
|symbolSources|string \| null|false|none|Custom symbol sources, as a JSON string, to use when symbolicating events.|
|enableNativeSourceServerMapping|boolean|false|none|Apply source server (srcsrv) information from native debug files to symbolicated frames.|
|scrubIPAddresses|boolean|false|none|Discard client IP addresses rather than storing them on events.|
|groupingConfig|string \| null|false|none|Identifier of the grouping algorithm used to assign events to issues.|
|groupingEnhancements|string \| null|false|none|Grouping enhancement rules, as a newline-delimited config string, adjusting which stack frames contribute to an issue.|
|fingerprintingRules|string \| null|false|none|Fingerprinting rules, as a newline-delimited config string, controlling how events are grouped into issues.|
|secondaryGroupingConfig|string \| null|false|none|Grouping algorithm run alongside the primary one during a grouping migration.|
|secondaryGroupingExpiry|integer \| null|false|none|Unix timestamp after which the secondary grouping algorithm stops running.|
|scrapeJavaScript|boolean|false|none|Allow Sentry to fetch source files and source maps from your servers.|
|enableAutoReleaseCreation|boolean|false|none|Automatically create releases from ingested events. When disabled, releases must be created manually (e.g. via the Sentry CLI).|
|allowedDomains|[string]|false|none|Origins permitted to send events to this project. Use `*` to allow any.|
|copy_from_project|integer|false|none|ID of a project whose settings, teams, and keys should be copied into this one.|
|dynamicSamplingBiases|[object]|false|none|Per-bias toggles adjusting which transactions dynamic sampling favors retaining.|
|tempestFetchScreenshots|boolean|false|none|Fetch screenshots attached to console crash reports. Requires the Tempest feature.|
|scmSourceContextEnabled|boolean|false|none|Enable on-demand source context fetching from SCM integrations for stack traces.|
|debugFilesRole|string \| null|false|none|The role required to download debug information files, ProGuard mappings and source maps. If not set, inherits from organization setting.<br><br>* `member` - Member<br>* `admin` - Admin<br>* `manager` - Manager<br>* `owner` - Owner|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|

|autofixAutomationTuning|off|
|autofixAutomationTuning|super_low|
|autofixAutomationTuning|low|
|autofixAutomationTuning|medium|
|autofixAutomationTuning|high|
|autofixAutomationTuning|always|
|debugFilesRole|member|
|debugFilesRole|admin|
|debugFilesRole|manager|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|ID of the event|
|groupID|string \| null|true|none|ID of the issue the event belongs to|
|eventID|string|true|none|ID of the event|
|projectID|string|true|none|ID of the project the event belongs to|
|message|string \| null|true|none|Event message|
|title|string|true|none|Event title|
|location|string \| null|true|none|Source location of the event, such as a file and line|
|platform|string \| null|true|none|Platform of the event, such as python or javascript|
|dateReceived|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|When Sentry received the event (ISO 8601)|
|size|integer \| null|true|none|Size of the event payload in bytes|
|entries|[object]|true|none|Event interfaces, such as exception, breadcrumbs and request, each with a type and data|
|dist|string \| null|true|none|Distribution of the release the event was sent with|
|packages|object|true|none|Modules loaded when the event occurred, keyed by module name with their versions|
|type|string|true|none|Event type, such as error, default or transaction|
|metadata|object|true|none|Event metadata|
|occurrence|object \| object \| null|true|none|Issue occurrence data for events in non-error issues, such as performance issues. Null otherwise|
|_meta|object|true|none|Metadata about changes Sentry made to the event's fields, such as data scrubbing or trimming|
|user|object \| null|true|none|User context of the event|
|tags|[object]|true|none|Tags attached to the event|
|contexts|object \| null|true|none|Contexts of the event, such as device, os, browser and runtime, keyed by alias|
|sdk|object \| null|true|none|SDK that sent the event|
|context|object \| null|true|none|Additional data sent with the event in its extra field|
|errors|[object]|true|none|Errors Sentry found while processing the event|
|crashFile|string \| null|false|none|Crash report attachment of the event, if any|
|culprit|string \| null|false|none|Function or module that caused the event|
|dateCreated|string(date-time)|false|none|When the event occurred (ISO 8601)|
|fingerprints|[string]|false|none|Grouping hashes calculated for the event|
|groupingConfig|object|false|none|Grouping configuration used to group the event|
|startTimestamp|number(double)|false|none|When the transaction started, as a Unix timestamp in seconds|
|endTimestamp|number(double)|false|none|When the transaction ended, as a Unix timestamp in seconds|
|measurements|object \| null|false|none|Measurements recorded for the transaction, such as web vitals, keyed by name|
|breakdowns|object \| null|false|none|Span operation breakdowns for the transaction, keyed by breakdown name|
|release|object \| null|true|none|Release the event was sent with. Null when the event has no release|
|userReport|object \| null|true|none|User feedback submitted for the event. Null when there's none|
|sdkUpdates|[object]|true|none|Suggested updates for the SDK that sent the event|
|resolvedWith|[string]|true|none|How the event's stack frames were resolved during processing, such as which source map lookup method was used|
|nextEventID|string \| null|true|none|ID of the next event in the issue. Null for the latest event or when adjacentEvents is collapsed|
|previousEventID|string \| null|true|none|ID of the previous event in the issue. Null for the first event or when adjacentEvents is collapsed|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|type|error|
|type|csp|
|type|nel|
|type|hpkp|
|type|expectct|
|type|expectstaple|
|type|transaction|
|type|generic|
|type|feedback|

This represents a Sentry Project Client Key.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|ID of the client key, same as its public key|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the client key|
|label|string|true|none|Name of the client key, same as name|
|public|string \| null|true|none|Public key|
|secret|string \| null|true|none|Secret key|
|projectId|integer|true|none|ID of the project the key belongs to|
|isActive|boolean|true|none|Whether the client key accepts events|
|rateLimit|object \| null|true|none|Rate limit for events sent with the key. Null when there's none|
|dsn|object|true|none|DSN and ingestion endpoints for the key|
|browserSdkVersion|string|true|none|JavaScript SDK version the Loader serves|
|browserSdk|object|true|none|JavaScript SDK versions the Loader can serve|
|dateCreated|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|When the client key was created (ISO 8601)|
|dynamicSdkLoaderOptions|object|true|none|Features the JavaScript SDK Loader enables|
|useCase|string|false|none|What the key is used for, such as user or profiling. Only included for superusers|

To<br>disable entirely set `rateLimit` to null.<br>```json<br>{<br>    "rateLimit": {<br>        "window": 7200, // time in seconds<br>        "count": 1000 // error cap<br>    }<br>}<br>```|

|hasInsightsQueues|boolean|true|none|Whether the project has sent queue spans used by Insights|

|teams|[object]|true|none|Teams with access to the project|

<h2 id="tocS_RateLimit">RateLimit</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaratelimit"></a>
<a id="schema_RateLimit"></a>
<a id="tocSratelimit"></a>
<a id="tocsratelimit"></a>

```json
{
  "count": 0,
  "window": 0
}
```

Applies a rate limit to cap the number of errors accepted during a given time window. To
disable entirely set `rateLimit` to null.
```json
{
    "rateLimit": {
        "window": 7200, // time in seconds
        "count": 1000 // error cap
    }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|count|integer \| null|false|none|none|
|window|integer \| null|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_ReleaseFileUpload">ReleaseFileUpload</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemareleasefileupload"></a>
<a id="schema_ReleaseFileUpload"></a>
<a id="tocSreleasefileupload"></a>
<a id="tocsreleasefileupload"></a>

```json
{
  "file": "http://example.com",
  "name": "string",
  "dist": "string",
  "header": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

Documents the multipart/form-data body of the release file upload endpoints.

The endpoints read the upload directly off ``request.data``; this serializer
exists to describe the request body in the OpenAPI schema.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|file|string(uri)|true|none|The multipart-encoded file contents to upload.|
|name|string|false|none|The name (full path) the file will be referenced as, e.g. the full web URI of a JavaScript file. Defaults to the uploaded file's name.|
|dist|string|false|none|The name of the distribution to associate the file with.|
|header|[string]|false|none|Headers to attach to the file, each formatted as a `"key:value"` string (for example, to define a content type). May be supplied multiple times.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|version|string|true|none|A version identifier for this release. Can be a version number, a commit hash, and so on.|

|dateReleased|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|An optional date that indicates when the release went live.  If not provided the current time is used.|
|commits|[object]|false|none|An optional list of commit data to be associated. Very long lists are truncated to the most recent commits.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the release. Can be `open` or `archived`.|
|owner|string|false|none|The username of the user to set as the release owner.|
|headCommits|[object]|false|none|(Deprecated) Use `refs` instead. An optional list of head commits to associate with the release, one per repository.|
|refs|[object]|false|none|An optional list of commit references, one per repository, used to associate commits with the release.|

Can also manage<br>        the organization's membership.<br>* `admin` - Can edit global integrations, manage projects, and add/remove teams.<br>        They automatically assume the Team Admin role for teams they join.<br>        Note: This role can no longer be assigned in Business and Enterprise plans. Use `TeamRoles` instead.<br>        |

|errorMessage|string \| null|true|none|Error message when the size analysis failed or didn't run|
|downloadSize|integer \| null|true|none|Download size of the build in bytes. Only set when the analysis completed|
|installSize|integer \| null|true|none|Install size of the build in bytes. Only set when the analysis completed|
|analysisDuration|number(double) \| null|true|none|How long the analysis took, in seconds. Only set when the analysis completed|
|analysisVersion|string \| null|true|none|Version of the analyzer that produced the results|
|baseBuildId|string \| null|true|none|ID of the base build the build is compared against. Null when there's no comparison|
|baseAppInfo|object \| null|true|none|App details of the base build. Null when there's no comparison|
|insights|object \| object \| null|true|none|Suggestions for reducing the build's size. Null when there are none|
|appComponents|[object]|true|none|Components of the build, such as watch apps or dynamic features, with their sizes|
|comparisons|[object]|true|none|Size comparisons against the base build, one per component. Null when there's no base build|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|state|PROCESSING|
|state|COMPLETED|
|state|FAILED|
|state|NOT_RAN|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|head_artifact_id|string|false|none|ID of the build the snapshot belongs to|
|base_artifact_id|string \| null|false|none|ID of the base build the snapshot is compared against|
|project_id|string|false|none|ID of the project|
|comparison_type|string|false|none|How the snapshot is compared: diff when a comparison exists, waiting_for_base when the build has a base commit but no comparison yet, or solo otherwise|
|state|string|false|none|State of the build: UPLOADING, UPLOADED, PROCESSED or FAILED|
|vcs_info|object|false|none|Version control details of the build|
|app_id|string \| null|false|none|App identifier of the build|
|is_selective|boolean|false|none|Whether the upload contained only a subset of the app's images|
|images|[object]|false|none|All images in the snapshot. Empty when comparison_type is diff|
|image_count|integer|false|none|Number of images in the snapshot|
|added|[object]|false|none|Images in the head snapshot but not the base|
|added_count|integer|false|none|Number of added images|
|removed|[object]|false|none|Images in the base snapshot but not the head|
|removed_count|integer|false|none|Number of removed images|
|renamed|[object]|false|none|Images whose file name changed but whose content didn't|
|renamed_count|integer|false|none|Number of renamed images|
|changed|[object]|false|none|Images whose changed pixels exceed the diff threshold, sorted by most changed first|
|changed_count|integer|false|none|Number of changed images|
|unchanged|[object]|false|none|Images that match the base snapshot|
|unchanged_count|integer|false|none|Number of unchanged images|
|errored|[object]|false|none|Images that couldn't be compared|
|errored_count|integer|false|none|Number of errored images|
|skipped|[object]|false|none|Base images that a selective upload didn't include|
|skipped_count|integer|false|none|Number of skipped images|
|diff_threshold|number(double) \| null|false|none|Fraction of changed pixels, from 0 to 1, above which an image counts as changed. Images can override it|
|comparison_state|string \| null|false|none|State of the latest comparison: pending, processing, success, failed, waiting_for_base or no_base_build|
|approval_status|string \| null|false|none|Approval status of the latest comparison: approved, auto_approved or requires_approval|
|comparison_error_message|string \| null|false|none|Error message when the latest comparison failed|
|approvers|[object]|false|none|People who approved the snapshot changes|
