```json
{
  "type": "http",
  "name": "string",
  "id": "string",
  "layout": {
    "type": "native",
    "casing": "lowercase"
  },
  "filters": {
    "filetypes": [
      "pe"
    ],
    "path_patterns": [
      "string"
    ],
    "requires_checksum": true
  },
  "url": "string",
  "username": "string",
  "password": "string",
  "bucket": "string",
  "region": "us-east-2",
  "access_key": "string",
  "secret_key": "string",
  "prefix": "string",
  "client_email": "string",
  "private_key": "string",
  "account": "string",
  "container": "string",
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "client_id": "string",
  "client_secret": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the source.<br><br>* `http` - SymbolServer (HTTP)<br>* `gcs` - Google Cloud Storage<br>* `s3` - Amazon S3<br>* `azure` - Azure Blob Storage|
|name|string|true|none|The human-readable name of the source.|
|id|string|false|none|The internal ID of the source. Must be distinct from all other source IDs and cannot start with '`sentry:`'. If this is not provided, a new UUID will be generated.|
|layout|object|false|none|Layout settings for the source. This is required for HTTP, GCS, and S3 sources.<br><br>**`type`** ***(string)*** - The layout of the folder structure. The options are:<br>- `native` - Platform-Specific (SymStore / GDB / LLVM)<br>- `symstore` - Microsoft SymStore<br>- `symstore_index2` - Microsoft SymStore (with index2.txt)<br>- `ssqp` - Microsoft SSQP<br>- `unified` - Unified Symbol Server Layout<br>- `debuginfod` - debuginfod<br>- `nnsymstore` - Nintendo Symbol Store<br><br>**`casing`** ***(string)*** - The layout of the folder structure. The options are:<br>- `default` - Default (mixed case)<br>- `uppercase` - Uppercase<br>- `lowercase` - Lowercase<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "layout": {<br>        "type": "native"<br>        "casing": "default"<br>    }<br>}<br>```|
|filters|object|false|none|Filter settings for the source. This is optional for all sources.<br><br>**`filetypes`** ***(list)*** - A list of file types that can be found on this source. If this is left empty, all file types will be enabled. The options are:<br>- `pe` - Windows executable files<br>- `pdb` - Windows debug files<br>- `portablepdb` - .NET portable debug files<br>- `mach_code` - MacOS executable files<br>- `mach_debug` - MacOS debug files<br>- `elf_code` - ELF executable files<br>- `elf_debug` - ELF debug files<br>- `wasm_code` - WASM executable files<br>- `wasm_debug` - WASM debug files<br>- `breakpad` - Breakpad symbol files<br>- `sourcebundle` - Source code bundles<br>- `uuidmap` - Apple UUID mapping files<br>- `bcsymbolmap` - Apple bitcode symbol maps<br>- `il2cpp` - Unity IL2CPP mapping files<br>- `proguard` - ProGuard mapping files<br><br>**`path_patterns`** ***(list)*** - A list of glob patterns to check against the debug and code file paths of debug files. Only files that match one of these patterns will be requested from the source. If this is left empty, no path-based filtering takes place.<br><br>**`requires_checksum`** ***(boolean)*** - Whether this source requires a debug checksum to be sent with each request. Defaults to `false`.<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "filters": {<br>        "filetypes": ["pe", "pdb", "portablepdb"],<br>        "path_patterns": ["*ffmpeg*"]<br>    }<br>}<br>```|
|url|string|false|none|The source's URL. Optional for HTTP sources, invalid for all others.|
|username|string|false|none|The user name for accessing the source. Optional for HTTP sources, invalid for all others.|
|password|string|false|none|The password for accessing the source. Optional for HTTP sources, invalid for all others.|
|bucket|string|false|none|The GCS or S3 bucket where the source resides. Required for GCS and S3 source, invalid for HTTP sources.|
|region|string|false|none|The source's [S3 region](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/s3.html). Required for S3 sources, invalid for all others.<br><br>* `us-east-2` - US East (Ohio)<br>* `us-east-1` - US East (N. Virginia)<br>* `us-west-1` - US West (N. California)<br>* `us-west-2` - US West (Oregon)<br>* `ap-east-1` - Asia Pacific (Hong Kong)<br>* `ap-south-1` - Asia Pacific (Mumbai)<br>* `ap-northeast-2` - Asia Pacific (Seoul)<br>* `ap-southeast-1` - Asia Pacific (Singapore)<br>* `ap-southeast-2` - Asia Pacific (Sydney)<br>* `ap-northeast-1` - Asia Pacific (Tokyo)<br>* `ca-central-1` - Canada (Central)<br>* `cn-north-1` - China (Beijing)<br>* `cn-northwest-1` - China (Ningxia)<br>* `eu-central-1` - EU (Frankfurt)<br>* `eu-west-1` - EU (Ireland)<br>* `eu-west-2` - EU (London)<br>* `eu-west-3` - EU (Paris)<br>* `eu-north-1` - EU (Stockholm)<br>* `sa-east-1` - South America (São Paulo)<br>* `us-gov-east-1` - AWS GovCloud (US-East)<br>* `us-gov-west-1` - AWS GovCloud (US)|
|access_key|string|false|none|The [AWS Access Key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/security-creds.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys).Required for S3 sources, invalid for all others.|
|secret_key|string|false|none|The [AWS Secret Access Key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/security-creds.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys).Required for S3 sources, invalid for all others.|
|prefix|string|false|none|The GCS, Azure or [S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-prefixes.html) prefix. Optional for GCS, Azure and S3 sources, invalid for HTTP.|
|client_email|string|false|none|The GCS email address for authentication. Required for GCS sources, invalid for all others.|
|private_key|string|false|none|The GCS private key. Required for GCS sources if not using impersonated tokens. Invalid for all others.|
|account|string|false|none|The Azure storage account name. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|
|container|string|false|none|The Azure blob container name. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|
|tenant_id|string|false|none|The Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|
|client_id|string|false|none|The Microsoft Entra application (client) ID. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|
|client_secret|string|false|none|The Microsoft Entra client secret. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|

Requires SDK >= 10.0.0.<br>```json<br>{<br>    "dynamicSdkLoaderOptions": {<br>        "hasReplay": true,<br>        "hasPerformance": true,<br>        "hasDebug": true,<br>        "hasFeedback": true,<br>        "hasLogsAndMetrics": true<br>    }<br>}<br>```|

|orgRole|string|false|none|The organization role of the member. The options are:<br><br>* `billing` - Can manage payment and compliance details.<br>* `member` - Can view and act on events, as well as view most other data within the organization.<br>* `manager` - Has full management access to all teams and projects. Can also manage<br>        the organization's membership.<br>* `owner` - Has unrestricted access to the organization, its data, and its<br>        settings. Can add, modify, and delete projects and members, as well as<br>        make billing and plan changes.<br>* `admin` - Can edit global integrations, manage projects, and add/remove teams.<br>        They automatically assume the Team Admin role for teams they join.<br>        Note: This role can no longer be assigned in Business and Enterprise plans. Use `TeamRoles` instead.<br>        |
|teamRoles|[object]|false|none|<br>Configures the team role of the member. The two roles are:<br>- `contributor` - Can view and act on issues. Depending on organization settings, they can also add team members.<br>- `admin` - Has full management access to their team's membership and projects.<br>```json<br>{<br>    "teamRoles": [<br>        {<br>            "teamSlug": "ancient-gabelers",<br>            "role": "admin"<br>        },<br>        {<br>            "teamSlug": "powerful-abolitionist",<br>            "role": "contributor"<br>        }<br>    ]<br>}<br>```<br>|

|orgRole|admin|

```json
{

  "headers": {
    "property1": null,

  },

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|headers|object|false|none|Additional headers to send with the check request.|
|timeout_ms|integer|true|none|The number of milliseconds the request will wait for a response before timing-out.|
|method|string|false|none|The HTTP method used to make the check request.<br><br>* `GET`<br>* `POST`<br>* `HEAD`<br>* `PUT`<br>* `DELETE`<br>* `PATCH`<br>* `OPTIONS`|
|trace_sampling|boolean|false|none|When enabled allows check requets to be considered for dowstream performance tracing.|
|response_capture_enabled|boolean|false|none|When enabled, response body and headers will be captured on check failures.|
|body|string \| null|false|none|The body to send with the check request.|
|interval_seconds|integer|true|none|Time in seconds between uptime checks.<br><br>* `60` - 1 minute<br>* `300` - 5 minutes<br>* `600` - 10 minutes<br>* `1200` - 20 minutes<br>* `1800` - 30 minutes<br>* `3600` - 1 hour|
|assertion|object \| null|false|none|The assertion to send with the check request.|

<h2 id="tocS_WidgetLayout">WidgetLayout</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemawidgetlayout"></a>
<a id="schema_WidgetLayout"></a>
<a id="tocSwidgetlayout"></a>
<a id="tocswidgetlayout"></a>

```json
{
  "x": 0,
  "y": 0,
  "w": 1,
  "h": 1,
  "min_h": 1
}
```

Widget grid layout position and dimensions.

The dashboard uses a 6-column grid. Required keys: x, y, w, h, minH.
Constraints: x (0-5), y (>= 0), w (1-6), h (>= 1), minH (>= 1), and x + w <= 6.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x|integer|true|none|Column position (0-indexed).|
|y|integer|true|none|Row position (0-indexed).|
|w|integer|true|none|Width in grid columns (1-6).|
|h|integer|true|none|Height in grid rows.|
|min_h|integer|true|none|Minimum height in grid rows.|

Allows parameters to be defined in snake case, but passed as camel case.

Errors are output in camel case.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the alert|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the existing alert|
|enabled|boolean|false|none|Whether the alert is enabled or disabled|
|detectorIds|[integer]|false|none|The IDs of the monitors to connect this alert to. Use 'Fetch an Organization's Monitors' to find the IDs.|
|config|object|false|none|<br>        Typically the frequency at which the alert will fire, in minutes.<br><br>        - `0`: 0 minutes<br>        - `5`: 5 minutes<br>        - `10`: 10 minutes<br>        - `30`: 30 minutes<br>        - `60`: 1 hour<br>        - `180`: 3 hours<br>        - `720`: 12 hours<br>        - `1440`: 24 hours<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "frequency": 60<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |
|environment|string \| null|false|none|The name of the environment for the alert to evaluate in|
|triggers|object|false|none|The conditions on which the alert will trigger. See available options below.<br>        ```json<br>        {<br>            "triggers": {<br>                "organizationId": "1",<br>                "logicType": "any-short",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "first_seen_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "issue_resolved_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "reappeared_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "regression_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "seer_activity_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": [<br>                            "rca_completed",<br>                            "solution_completed",<br>                            "coding_completed",<br>                            "pr_ready_for_review"<br>                        ],<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            }<br>        }<br>        ```<br>        |
|actionFilters|[object]|false|none|The filters to run before the action will fire and the action(s) to fire.<br><br>        `logicType` can be one of `any-short`, `all`, or `none`.<br><br>        Below is a basic example. See below for all other options.<br><br>        ```json<br>            "actionFilters": [<br>                {<br>                    "logicType": "any",<br>                    "conditions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "type": "level",<br>                            "comparison": {<br>                                "level": 50,<br>                                "match": "eq"<br>                            },<br>                            "conditionResult": true<br>                        }<br>                    ],<br>                    "actions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "id": "123",<br>                            "type": "email",<br>                            "integrationId": null,<br>                            "data": {},<br>                            "config": {<br>                                "targetType": "user",<br>                                "targetDisplay": null,<br>                                "targetIdentifier": "56789"<br>                            },<br>                            "status": "active"<br>                        }<br>                    ]<br>                }<br>            ]<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Conditions<br><br>        **Issue Age**<br>        - `time`: One of `minute`, `hour`, `day`, or `week`.<br>        - `value`: A positive integer.<br>        - `comparisonType`: One of `older` or `newer`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "age_comparison",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "time": "minute",<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "comparisonType": "older"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Assignment**<br>        - `targetType`: Who the issue is assigned to<br>            - `Unassigned`: Unassigned<br>            - `Member`: Assigned to a user<br>            - `Team`: Assigned to a team<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the user or team from the `targetType`. Enter "" if `targetType` is `Unassigned`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "assigned_to",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "targetType": "Member",<br>                    "targetIdentifier": 123456<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Category**<br>        - `value`: The issue category to filter to.<br>            - `1`: Error issues<br>            - `6`: Feedback issues<br>            - `10`: Outage issues<br>            - `11`: Metric issues<br>            - `12`: DB Query issues<br>            - `13`: HTTP Client issues<br>            - `14`: Front end issues<br>            - `15`: Mobile issues<br>            - `17`: Preprod issues<br>            - `19`: Configuration issues<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_category",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 1<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Frequency**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing how many times the issue has to happen before the alert will fire.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_occurrences",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **De-escalation**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority threshold the issue must de-escalate below.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_deescalating",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Priority**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority the issue must be for the alert to fire.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_greater_or_equal",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Users Affected**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of users that must be affected before the alert will fire.<br>        - `filters`: A list of additional sub-filters to evaluate before the alert will fire.<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of users affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_unique_user_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "filters": [{"key": "foo", "match": "eq", "value": "bar"}],<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of events in an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percent of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Count**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Percentage of sessions affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Percent**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Attribute**<br>        The event's `attribute` value `match` `value`<br><br>        - `attribute`: The event attribute to match on. Valid values are: `message`, `platform`, `environment`, `type`, `error.handled`, `error.unhandled`, `error.main_thread`, `exception.type`, `exception.value`, `user.id`, `user.email`, `user.username`, `user.ip_address`, `http.method`, `http.url`, `http.status_code`, `sdk.name`, `stacktrace.code`, `stacktrace.module`, `stacktrace.filename`, `stacktrace.abs_path`, `stacktrace.package`, `unreal.crash_type`, `app.in_foreground`.<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_attribute",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "match": "co",<br>                    "value": "bar",<br>                    "attribute": "message"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Tagged Event**<br>        The event's tags `key` match `value`<br>        - `key`: The tag value<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "tagged_event",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "key": "level",<br>                    "match": "eq",<br>                    "value": "error"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Latest Release**<br>        The event is from the latest release<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_release",<br>                "comparison": true,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Release Age**<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_adopted_release",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "environment": "production",<br>                    "ageComparison": "older",<br>                    "releaseAgeType": "oldest"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Level**<br>        The event's level is `match` `level`<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `eq`: Equal<br>            - `gte`: Greater than or equal<br>            - `lte`: Less than or equal<br>        - `level`: The event level<br>            - `50`: Fatal<br>            - `40`: Error<br>            - `30`: Warning<br>            - `20`: Info<br>            - `10`: Debug<br>            - `0`: Sample<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "level",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "level": 50,<br>                    "match": "eq"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Actions<br>        A list of actions that take place when all required conditions and filters for the alert are met. See below for a list of possible actions.<br><br><br>        **Notify on Preferred Channel**<br>        - `data`: A dictionary with the fallthrough type option when choosing to notify Suggested Assignees. Leave empty if notifying a user or team.<br>            - `fallthroughType`<br>                - `ActiveMembers`<br>                - `AllMembers`<br>                - `NoOne`<br>        - `config`: A dictionary with the configuration options for notification.<br>            - `targetType`: The type of recipient to notify<br>                - `user`: User<br>                - `team`: Team<br>                - `issue_owners`: Suggested Assignees<br>            - `targetDisplay`: null<br>            - `targetIdentifier`: The id of the user or team to notify. Leave null for Suggested Assignees.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{},<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"user",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"232692"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            },<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{<br>                    "fallthroughType":"ActiveMembers"<br>                },<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"issue_owners",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":""}<br>                ,<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        **Notify on Slack**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the channel to notify in.<br>        `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"slack",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on PagerDuty**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The severity level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"pagerduty",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"default"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Discord**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["tags"]`: Comma separated list of tags to add to the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"discord",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"12345",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"1234",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "tags":"transaction,environment"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on MSTeams**<br>        - `targetIdentifier` - The integration ID associated with the Microsoft Teams team.<br>        - `targetDisplay` - The name of the channel to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"msteams",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"19:a4b3kghaghgkjah357y6847@thread.skype",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on OpsGenie**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the Opsgenie team.<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the Opsgenie team to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The priority level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"opsgenie",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456-Error-Service",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"P3"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Azure DevOps**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"vsts",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira Server ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira_server",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a GitHub issue**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"github",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                  "additional_fields": {<br>                      "assignee": "",<br>                      "integration": "2345",<br>                      "labels": [],<br>                      "repo": "example-repo",<br>                  },<br>                  "dynamic_form_fields": [<br>                      {<br>                        "choices": [["YourOrg/example-repo", "example-repo"]],<br>                        "default": "YourOrg/example-repo",<br>                        "label": "GitHub Repository",<br>                        "name": "repo",<br>                        "required": true<br>                        "type": "select",<br>                        "updatesForm": true,<br>                        "url": "/extensions/github/search/example-repo/1234567/",<br>                      },<br>                  ],<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |
|owner|string \| null|false|none|<br>            The ID user or team who owns the monitor or alert prefaced by the string 'user' or 'team'.<br><br>            **User**<br>            ```json<br>                "user:123456"<br>            ```<br><br>            **Team**<br>            ```json<br>                "team:456789"<br>            ```<br>        |

<h2 id="tocS__LegacyBrowserFilter">_LegacyBrowserFilter</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schema_legacybrowserfilter"></a>
<a id="schema__LegacyBrowserFilter"></a>
<a id="tocS_legacybrowserfilter"></a>
<a id="tocs_legacybrowserfilter"></a>

```json
{
  "active": true,
  "subfilters": [
    "ie"
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|active|boolean|false|none|Toggle the browser-extensions, localhost, filtered-transaction, or web-crawlers filter on or off.|
|subfilters|[string]|false|none|<br>Specifies which legacy browser filters should be active. Anything excluded from the list will be<br>disabled. The options are:<br>- `ie` - Internet Explorer Version 11 and lower<br>- `edge` - Edge Version 110 and lower<br>- `safari` - Safari Version 15 and lower<br>- `firefox` - Firefox Version 110 and lower<br>- `chrome` - Chrome Version 110 and lower<br>- `opera` - Opera Version 99 and lower<br>- `android` - Android Version 3 and lower<br>- `opera_mini` - Opera Mini Version 34 and lower<br><br>Deprecated options:<br>- `ie_pre_9` - Internet Explorer Version 8 and lower<br>- `ie9` - Internet Explorer Version 9<br>- `ie10` - Internet Explorer Version 10<br>- `ie11` - Internet Explorer Version 11<br>- `safari_pre_6` - Safari Version 5 and lower<br>- `opera_pre_15` - Opera Version 14 and lower<br>- `opera_mini_pre_8` - Opera Mini Version 8 and lower<br>- `android_pre_4` - Android Version 3 and lower<br>- `edge_pre_79` - Edge Version 18 and lower (non Chromium based)<br>|
